9.56.26: प्राणान् श्रियं च राज्यं च त्यक्त्वा शेष्यति भूतले ।
राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य श्रुत्वा पुत्रं निपातितम् ॥२६॥
9.56.30: स्मर तद् दुष्कृतं कर्म यद् वृत्तं वारणावते ।
9.56.31: द्यूतेन वञ्चितो राजा यत् त्वया सौबलेन च ।
वने दुःखं च यत् प्राप्तमस्माभिस्त्वत्कृतं महत् ॥३१॥
9.56.32: तत् सर्वं पातयाम्यद्य दिष्ट्या दृष्टोऽसि दुर्मते ॥३२॥
9.56.34: हतो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च तथा शल्यः प्रतापवान् ।
9.56.36: एते चान्ये च बहवो निहतास्त्वत्कृते नृपाः ।
9.56.38: किं कत्थनेन बहुना युध्यस्व त्वं वृकोदर ।
9.56.39: न हि दुर्योधनः क्षुद्र केनचित् त्वद्विधेन वै ।
9.56.41: किं वाचा बहुनोक्तेन कत्थितेन च दुर्मते ।
वाणी सम्पद्यतामेषा कर्मणा मा चिरं कृथाः ॥४१॥
9.56.42: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्व एवाभ्यपूजयन् ।
9.56.43: भूयो धीरां मतिं चक्रे युद्धाय कुरुनन्दनः ॥४३॥
9.56.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि गदायुद्धारम्भे षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः ॥५६॥
9.57.6: तथा तस्मिन् वर्तमाने सङ्कुले तुमुले भृशम् ।
9.57.8: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महावीर्यौ समाश्वस्तौ नरर्षभौ ।
9.57.11: समागम्य ततो भूयो भ्रातरौ बलिनां वरौ ।
9.57.12: ददृशुः प्रेक्षका राजन् रौद्रीं विशसनीं गदाम् ॥१२॥
9.57.15: चरंश्च विविधान् मार्गान् मण्डलानि च भारत ।
अशोभत तदा वीरो भूय एव वृकोदरः ॥१५॥
9.57.27: आहतस्तु ततो भीमः पुत्रेण तव भारत ॥२७॥
9.57.31: स चरन् विविधान् मार्गान् मण्डलानि च भागशः ॥३१॥
9.57.38: दृष्ट्वा व्यवस्थितं भीमं तव पुत्रो महाबलः ॥३८॥
9.57.42: तां नामृष्यत कौरव्यो गदां प्रतिहतां रणे ॥४२॥
9.57.43: स सव्यं मण्डलं राजा उद्भ्राम्य कृतनिश्चयः ॥४३॥
9.57.44: तया त्वभिहतो भीमः पुत्रेण तव पाण्डवः ॥४४॥
9.57.46: यद् गदाभिहतो भीमो नाकम्पत पदात् पदम् ।
9.57.48: सा तु मोघा गदा राजन् पतन्ती भीमचोदिता ॥४८॥
9.57.49: आस्थाय कौशिकान् मार्गानुत्पतन् स पुनः पुनः ॥४९॥
9.57.53: स तु तेन प्रहारेण मातङ्ग इव रोषितः ॥५३॥
9.57.54: ततस्तु तरसा भीमो गदया तनयं तव ॥५४॥
9.57.56: आविध्यत गदां राजन् समुद्दिश्य सुतं तव ।
9.57.58: तेषां तु निनदं श्रुत्वा सृञ्जयानां नरर्षभः ॥५८॥
9.57.62: स भूयः शुशुभे पार्थस्ताडितो गदया रणे ।
9.57.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि गदायुद्धे सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः ॥५७॥
9.58.2: कस्य वा को गुणो भूयानेतद् वद जनार्दन ॥२॥
9.58.4: अन्यायेन तु युध्यन् वै हन्यादेव सुयोधनम् ॥४॥
9.58.5: मायया निर्जिता देवैरसुरा इति नः श्रुतम् ।
विरोचनस्तु शक्रेण मायया निर्जितः स वै ॥५॥
9.58.7: ऊरू भेत्स्यामि ते सङ्ख्ये गदयेति सुयोधनम् ॥७॥
9.58.10: पुनरेव तु वक्ष्यामि पाण्डवेय निबोध मे ।
9.58.11: कृत्वा हि सुमहत् कर्म हत्वा भीष्ममुखान् कुरून् ।
जयः प्राप्तो यशः प्राग्र्यं वैरं च प्रतियातितम् ॥११॥
9.58.12: तदेवं विजयः प्राप्तः पुनः संशयितः कृतः ।
9.58.18: को न्वेष संयुगे प्राज्ञः पुनर्द्वन्द्वे समाह्वयेत् ।
अपि नो निर्जितं राज्यं न हरेत सुयोधनः ॥१८॥
9.58.20: एष वः कौरवो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो भविष्यति ॥२०॥
9.58.22: गृह्य सञ्ज्ञां ततो भीमो गदया व्यचरद् रणे ।
9.58.33: समरे प्रद्रुतौ तौ तु वृषभाक्षौ तरस्विनौ ।
9.58.36: अवाक्षिपद् गदां तस्मिन् वेगेन महता बली ॥३६॥
9.58.37: आक्षिपन्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते ।
अवासर्पत्ततः स्थानात् सा मोघा न्यपतद् भुवि ॥३७॥
9.58.40: दुर्योधनो न तं वेद पीडितं पाण्डवं रणे ।
9.58.41: अतो न प्राहरत् तस्मै पुनरेव तवात्मजः ॥४१॥
9.58.46: ऊरुभ्यां प्राहिणोद् राजन् गदां वेगेन पाण्डवः ॥४६॥
9.58.51: तथा शोणितवर्षं च पांशुवर्षं च भारत ॥५१॥
9.58.52: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पिशाचानां तथैव च ॥५२॥
9.58.54: ये तत्र वाजिनः शेषा गजाश्च मनुजैः सह ॥५४॥
9.58.60: दुर्योधने तदा राजन् पतिते तनये तव ।
9.59.14: तव पुत्रं तथा हत्वा कत्थमानं वृकोदरम् ।
9.59.16: मा शिरोऽस्य पदा मार्दीर्मा धर्मस्तेऽतिगो भवेत् ।
9.59.17: मा स्प्राक्षीर्भीम पादेन राजानं ज्ञातिमेव च ॥१७॥
9.59.19: उत्सन्नपिण्डो भ्राता च नैतन्न्याय्यं कृतं त्वया ॥१९॥
9.59.22: तात मन्युर्न ते कार्यो नात्मा शोच्यस्त्वया तथा ।
9.59.23: यद् वयं त्वां जिघांसामस्त्वं चास्मान् कुरुसत्तम ॥२३॥
9.59.28: भ्रातॄणां चैव पुत्राणां तथा वै शोकविह्वलाः ॥२८॥
9.59.29: त्वमेकः सुस्थितो राजन् स्वर्गे ते निलयो ध्रुवः ॥२९॥
9.59.30: वयं नरकसञ्ज्ञं वै दुःखं प्राप्स्याम दारुणम् ।
9.59.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि युधिष्ठिरविलापे एकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥५९॥
9.60.4: कुर्वन्नार्तस्वरं घोरं धिग् धिग् भीमेत्युवाच ह ॥४॥
9.60.5: अहो धिग् यदधो नाभेः प्रहृतं धर्मविग्रहे ।
नैतद् दृष्टं गदायुद्धे कृतवान् यद् वृकोदरः ॥५॥
9.60.6: अधो नाभ्या न हन्तव्यमिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः ।
9.60.7: तस्य तत् तद् ब्रुवाणस्य रोषः समभवन्महान् ।
9.60.8: न चैष पतितः कृष्ण केवलं मत्समोऽसमः ॥८॥
9.60.10d1: न विव्यथे महाराज दृष्ट्वा हलधरं बली ॥
9.60.14: आत्मन्यपि च मित्रे च विपरीतं यदा भवेत् ॥१४॥
9.60.17: इति पूर्वं प्रतिज्ञातं भीमेन हि सभातले ॥१७॥
9.60.18: ऊरू ते भेत्स्यते भीमो गदयेति परन्तप ॥१८॥
9.60.19: अतो दोषं न पश्यामि मा क्रुद्ध्यस्व प्रलम्बहन् ।
यौनः स्वैः सुखहार्दैश्च सम्बन्धः सह पाण्डवैः ॥१९॥
9.60.20: तेषां वृद्ध्या हि वृद्धिर्नो मा क्रुधः पुरुषर्षभ ।
9.60.21: धर्मः सुचरितः सद्भिः स च द्वाभ्यां नियच्छति ।
9.60.23: तदिदं व्याकुलं सर्वं कृतं धर्मस्य पीडनात् ।
भीमसेनेन गोविन्द कामं त्वं तु यथाऽऽत्थ माम् ॥२३॥
9.60.24: भवान् प्रख्यायते लोके तस्मात् संशाम्य मा क्रुधः ॥२४॥
9.60.25: प्राप्तं कलियुगं विद्धि प्रतिज्ञां पाण्डवस्य च ।
9.60.25d1: अधर्मो विद्यते नात्र यद् भीमो हतवान् रिपुम् ॥
9.60.25d6: बभञ्ज गदया चोरू न स्थाने न च मण्डले ॥
9.60.26: नैव प्रीतमना रामो वचनं प्राह संसदि ॥२६॥
9.60.35: न ममैतत् प्रियं कृष्ण यद् राजानं वृकोदरः ।
पदा मूर्ध्न्यस्पृशत् क्रोधान्न च हृष्ये कुलक्षये ॥३५॥
9.60.36: बहूनि परुषाण्युक्त्वा वनं प्रस्थापिताः स्म ह ॥३६॥
9.60.38: लभतां पाण्डवः कामं धर्मेऽधर्मे च वा कृते ॥३८॥
9.60.40: अन्वमोदत तत् सर्वं यद् भीमेन कृतं युधि ॥४०॥
9.60.40d1: नोवाच वचनं किञ्चिद् भ्रातरं, साध्वसाधु वा ॥
9.60.47: गतो वैरस्य निधनं हतो राजा सुयोधनः ।
9.60.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि बलदेवसान्त्वने षष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥६०॥
9.61.7: दुष्करं भवता कर्म रणेऽद्य सुमहत् कृतम् ।
9.61.9: चरन्तं विविधान् मार्गान् मण्डलानि च सर्वशः ।
9.61.10: वैरस्य च गतः पारं त्वमिहान्यैः सुदुर्गमम् ।
9.61.13: मूर्ध्नि तेषां कृतः पादो दिष्ट्या ते स्वेन कर्मणा ॥१३॥
9.61.14: भीम दिष्ट्या पृथिव्यां ते प्रथितं सुमहद् यशः ॥१४॥
9.61.15: एवं नूनं हते वृत्रे शक्रं नन्दन्ति वन्दिनः ।
तथा त्वां निहतामित्रं वयं नन्दाम भारत ॥१५॥
9.61.16: अद्यापि न विकृष्यन्ते तानि तद् विद्धि भारत ॥१६॥
9.61.17: तान् हृष्टान् पुरुषव्याघ्रान् पञ्चालान् पाण्डवैः सह ॥१७॥
9.61.18: न न्याय्यं निहतं शत्रुं भूयो हन्तुं नराधिपाः ॥१८॥
9.61.21: नैष योग्योऽद्य मित्रं वा शत्रुर्वा पुरुषाधमः ॥२१॥
9.61.23: इति श्रुत्वा त्वधिक्षेपं कृष्णाद् दुर्योधनो नृपः ॥२३॥
9.61.27: कंसदासस्य दायाद न ते लज्जास्त्यनेन वै ॥२७॥
9.61.28: ऊरू भिन्धीति भीमस्य स्मृतिं मिथ्या प्रयच्छता ॥२८॥
9.61.30: जिह्मैरुपायैर्बहुभिर्न ते लज्जा न ते घृणा ।
9.61.32: आचार्यो न्यासितः शस्त्रं किं तन्न विदितं मया ।
9.61.37: यदि मां चापि कर्णं च भीष्मद्रोणौ च संयुतौ ॥३७॥
9.61.38: ऋजुना प्रतियुध्येथा न ते स्याद् विजयो ध्रुवम् ।
9.61.41: याच्यमानं मया मूढ पित्र्यमंशं न दित्ससि ॥४१॥
9.61.42: विषं ते भीमसेनाय दत्तं सर्वे च पाण्डवाः ॥४२॥
9.61.43: सभायां याज्ञसेनी च कृष्टा द्यूते रजस्वला ॥४३॥
9.61.45: जयद्रथेन पापेन यत् कृष्णा क्लेशिता वने ॥४५॥
9.61.47d5: न जघान रणे कर्णं मैवं वोचः सुदुर्मते ॥
9.61.47d7: त्वं च भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च द्रोणो द्रौणिस्तथा कृपः ।
9.61.47d8: स्मर पार्थस्य विक्रान्तं गन्धर्वेषु कृतं तदा ।
अधर्मः कोऽत्र गान्धारे पाण्डवैर्यत् कृतं त्वयि ॥
9.61.47d9: जितवन्तो रणे वीरा पापोऽसि निधनं गतः ॥
9.61.49: वृद्धा नोपासिताश्चैव हितं वाक्यं न ते श्रुतम् ।
9.61.50: अधीतं विधिवद् दत्तं भूः प्रशास्ता ससागरा ॥५०॥
9.61.51: मूर्ध्नि स्थितममित्राणां को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
9.61.52: तदिदं निधनं प्राप्तं को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
देवार्हा मानुषा भोगाः प्राप्ता असुलभा नृपैः ॥५२॥
9.61.53: ऐश्वर्यं चोत्तमं प्राप्तं को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
9.61.54d1: न मे विषादो भीमेन पादेन शिर आहतम् ।
काका वा कङ्कगृध्रा वा निधास्यन्ति पदं क्षणात् ॥
9.61.57: ववौ च सुरभिर्वायुः पुण्यगन्धो मृदुः सुखः ।
9.61.59: भीष्मं द्रोणं तथा कर्णं भूरिश्रवसमेव च ॥५९॥
9.61.62: नैष शक्यः कदाचित् तु हन्तुं धर्मेण पार्थिवः ।
ते वा भीष्ममुखाः सर्वे महेष्वासा महारथाः ॥६२॥
9.61.64: यदि नैवंविधं जातु कुर्यां जिह्ममहं रणे ।
कुतो वो विजयो भूयः कुतो राज्यं कुतो धनम् ॥६४॥
9.61.65: न शक्या धर्मतो हन्तुं लोकपालैरपि स्वयम् ॥६५॥
9.61.66: न शक्यो धर्मतो हन्तुं कालेनापीह दण्डिना ॥६६॥
9.61.67: न च वो हृदि कर्तव्यं यदयं घातितो रिपुः ।
9.61.71: ततः प्राध्मापयन् शङ्खान् पाञ्चजन्यं च माधवः ।
9.61.71d4: आपुपूरे नभः सर्वं पृथिवी च चचाल ह ॥
9.61.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि कृष्णपाण्डवदुर्योधनसंवादे एकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥६१॥
9.62.11: अथ पश्चात् ततः कृष्णो रश्मीनुत्सृज्य वाजिनाम् ।
9.62.15: तं तथा भस्मभूतं तु दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुसुताः प्रभो ।
9.62.17: तन्मे ब्रूहि महाबाहो श्रोतव्यं यदि मन्यसे ॥१७॥
9.62.21: दिष्ट्या जयसि कौन्तेय दिष्ट्या ते शत्रवो जिताः ।
9.62.22: त्वं चापि कुशली राजन् माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ।
9.62.24: आनीय मधुपर्कं मां यत् पुरा त्वमवोचथाः ।
एष भ्राता सखा चैव तव कृष्ण धनञ्जयः ॥२४॥
9.62.26: स सव्यसाची गुप्तस्ते विजयी च जनेश्वर ।
9.62.32: यतो धर्मस्ततः कृष्णो यतः कृष्णस्ततो जयः ।
इत्येवमुक्ते ते वीराः शिबिरं तव भारत ॥३२॥
9.62.33: रजतं जातरूपं च मणीनथ च मौक्तिकान् ॥३३॥
9.62.36: ते तु वीराः समाश्वस्य वाहनान्यवमुच्य च ।
9.62.38: तथेत्युक्त्वा हि ते सर्वे पाण्डवाः सात्यकिस्तथा ।
9.62.40: तत्र ते गमनं प्राप्तं रोचते तव माधव ॥४०॥
9.62.45: स प्रायात् पाण्डवैरुक्तस्तत् पुरं सात्वतां वरः ।
9.62.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि वासुदेवप्रेषणे द्विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥६२॥
9.63.2: यदा पूर्वं गतः कृष्णः शमार्थं कौरवान् प्रति ।
न च तं लब्धवान् कामं ततो युद्धमभूदिदम् ॥२॥
9.63.3: निहतेषु तु योधेषु हते दुर्योधने तदा ।
9.63.4: विद्रुते शिबिरे शून्ये प्राप्ते यशसि चोत्तमे ।
किं नु तत् कारणं ब्रह्मन् येन कृष्णो गतः पुनः ॥४॥
9.63.5: न चैतत् कारणं ब्रह्मन्नल्पं विप्रतिभाति मे ।
9.63.10: घोरेण तपसा युक्तां त्रैलोक्यमपि सा दहेत् ॥१०॥
9.63.13: कथं दुःखमिदं तीव्रं गान्धारी सा सहिष्यति ।
9.63.17: यथा साह्यं पुरा दत्तं हताश्च विबुधद्विषः ॥१७॥
9.63.18: सारथ्येन च वार्ष्णेय भवता हि धृता वयम् ॥१८॥
9.63.19: यदि न त्वं भवेर्नाथः फाल्गुनस्य महारणे ।
कथं शक्यो रणे जेतुं भवेदेष बलार्णवः ॥१९॥
9.63.21: अस्मत्कृते त्वया कृष्ण वाचः सुपरुषाः श्रुताः ।
शस्त्राणां च निपाता वै वज्रस्पर्शोपमा रणे ॥२१॥
9.63.22: ते च ते सफला जाता हते दुर्योधनेऽच्युत ।
तत् सर्वं न यथा नश्येत् पुनः कृष्ण तथा कुरु ॥२२॥
9.63.23: सन्देहदोलां प्राप्तं नश्चेतः कृष्ण जये सति ।
गान्धार्या हि महाबाहो क्रोधं बुद्ध्यस्व माधव ॥२३॥
9.63.24: सा हि नित्यं महाभागा तपसोग्रेण कर्शिता ।
9.63.25: तस्याः प्रसादनं वीर प्राप्तकालं मतं मम ।
9.63.26: तत्र मे गमनं प्राप्तं रोचते तव माधव ॥२६॥
9.63.27: त्वं हि कर्ता विकर्ता च लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययः ॥२७॥
9.63.31: आमन्त्र्य दारुकं प्राह रथः सज्जो विधीयताम् ।
9.63.39: प्रक्षाल्य वारिणा नेत्रे ह्याचम्य च यथाविधि ।
9.63.40: न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किञ्चिद् वृद्धस्य तव भारत ।
कालस्य च यथावृत्तं तत् ते सुविदितं प्रभो ॥४०॥
9.63.41: कथं कुलक्षयो न स्यात्तथा क्षत्रस्य भारत ॥४१॥
9.63.43: अन्ये च बहवः क्लेशात् त्वशक्तैरिव सर्वदा ॥४३॥
9.63.46: द्रोणेन च सपुत्रेण विदुरेण च धीमता ॥४६॥
9.63.47: याचितस्त्वं शमं नित्यं न च तत् कृतवानसि ।
9.63.49: मा च दोषान् महाप्राज्ञ पाण्डवेषु निवेशय ।
9.63.50: एतत् सर्वं तु विज्ञाय ह्यात्मदोषकृतं फलम् ॥५०॥
9.63.51: कुलं वंशश्च पिण्डाश्च यच्च पुत्रकृतं फलम् ॥५१॥
9.63.52: त्वं चैव कुरुशार्दूल गान्धारी च यशस्विनी ॥५२॥
9.63.53: मा शुचो नरशार्दूल पाण्डवान् प्रति किल्बिषम् ।
9.63.54: जानासि च महाबाहो धर्मराजस्य या त्वयि ॥५४॥
9.63.56: दह्यते स दिवा रात्रौ न च शर्माधिगच्छति ।
त्वां चैव नरशार्दूल गान्धारीं च यशस्विनीम् ॥५६॥
9.63.59: सौबलेयि निबोध त्वं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥५९॥
9.63.60: जानासि च यथा राज्ञि सभायां मम संनिधौ ॥६०॥
9.63.61: उक्तवत्यसि कल्याणि न च ते तनयैः कृतम् ॥६१॥
9.63.62: शृणु मूढ वचो मह्यं यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः ॥६२॥
9.63.63: एवं विदित्वा कल्याणि मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः ॥६३॥
9.63.64: पाण्डवानां विनाशाय मा ते बुद्धिः कदाचन ।
9.63.67: सा मे व्यवस्थिता श्रुत्वा तव वाक्यं जनार्दन ।
9.63.70: समाश्वास्य च गान्धारीं धृतराष्ट्रं च माधवः ॥७०॥
9.63.71: ततस्त्वरित उत्थाय पादौ मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य च ॥७१॥
9.63.72: आपृच्छे त्वां कुरुश्रेष्ठ मा च शोके मनः कृथाः ॥७२॥
9.63.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि धृतराष्ट्रगान्धारीसमाश्वासने त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥६३॥
9.64.1: अधिष्ठितः पदा मूर्ध्नि भग्नसक्थो महीं गतः ।
9.64.3: राज्ञा यदुक्तं भग्नेन तस्मिन् व्यसन आगते ॥३॥
9.64.4: यमयन् मूर्धजांस्तत्र वीक्ष्य चैव दिशो दश ॥४॥
9.64.6: बाहू धरण्यां निष्पिष्य सुदुर्मत्त इव द्विपः ।
9.64.7: भीष्मे शान्तनवे नाथे कर्णे शस्त्रभृतां वरे ॥७॥
9.64.8: गौतमे शकुनौ चापि द्रोणे चास्त्रभृतां वरे ।
अश्वत्थाम्नि तथा शल्ये शूरे च कृतवर्मणि ॥८॥
9.64.12: भूरिश्रवसि कर्णे च भीष्मे द्रोणे च श्रीमति ।
इदं चाकीर्तिजं कर्म नृशंसैः पाण्डवैः कृतम् ॥१२॥
9.64.13: येन ते सत्सु निर्वेदं गमिष्यन्ति हि मे मतिः ।
9.64.14: अधर्मेण जयं लब्ध्वा को नु हृष्येत पण्डितः ॥१४॥
9.64.16: प्रतपन्तं श्रिया जुष्टं वर्तमानं च बन्धुषु ॥१६॥
9.64.17: एवं कुर्यान्नरो यो हि स वै सञ्जय पूजितः ।
अभिज्ञौ युद्धधर्मस्य मम माता पिता च मे ॥१७॥
9.64.18: तौ हि सञ्जय दुःखार्तौ विज्ञाप्यौ वचनाद्धि मे ।
इष्टं भृत्या भृताः सम्यग् भूः प्रशास्ता ससागरा ॥१८॥
9.64.19: दत्ता दाया यथाशक्ति मित्राणां च प्रियं कृतम् ॥१९॥
9.64.20: अमित्रा बाधिताः सर्वे को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
मानिता बान्धवाः सर्वे वश्यः सम्पूजितो जनः ॥२०॥
9.64.21: त्रितयं सेवितं सर्वं को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
9.64.22: आजानेयैस्तथा यातं को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
9.64.23: प्रियेभ्यः प्रकृतं साधु को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
9.64.24: स्वधर्मेण जिता लोकाः को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
दिष्ट्या नाहं जितः सङ्ख्ये परान् प्रेष्यवदाश्रितः ॥२४॥
9.64.25: दिष्ट्या मे विपुला लक्ष्मीर्मृते त्वन्यगता विभो ।
9.64.26: निधनं तन्मया प्राप्तं को नु स्वन्ततरो मया ।
9.64.27: दिष्ट्या न विमतिं काञ्चिद् भजित्वा तु पराजितः ।
सुप्तं वाथ प्रमत्तं वा यथा हन्याद् विषेण वा ॥२७॥
9.64.35: कथं भ्रातॄन् हतान् श्रुत्वा भर्तारं च स्वसा मम ॥३५॥
9.64.36: स्नुषाभिः प्रस्नुषाभिश्च वृद्धो राजा पिता मम ॥३६॥
9.64.41: प्रलापं नृपतेः श्रुत्वा व्यद्रवन्त दिशो दश ।
9.64.43: ध्यात्वा च सुचिरं कालं जग्मुरार्ता यथागतम् ॥४३॥
9.64.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि दुर्योधनविलापे चतुःषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥६४॥
9.65.1: वार्तिकाणां सकाशात् तु श्रुत्वा दुर्योधनं हतम् ।
9.65.9: सामर्षं तं नरव्याघ्रं व्याघ्रं निपतितं यथा ॥९॥
9.65.10: ते तं दृष्ट्वा महेष्वासं भूतले पतितं नृपम् ।
9.65.13: न नूनं विद्यते सत्यं मानुषे किञ्चिदेव हि ।
यत्र त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र शेषे पांसुषु रूषितः ॥१३॥
9.65.14: भूत्वा हि नृपतिः पूर्वं समाज्ञाप्य च मेदिनीम् ।
9.65.15: दुःशासनं न पश्यामि नापि कर्णं महारथम् ।
नापि तान् सुहृदः सर्वान् किमिदं भरतर्षभ ॥१५॥
9.65.16: दुःखं नूनं कृतान्तस्य गतिं ज्ञातुं कथञ्चन ।
लोकानां च भवान् यत्र शेषे पांसुषु रूषितः ॥१६॥
9.65.17: सतृणं ग्रसते पांसुं पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम् ॥१७॥
9.65.18: क्व ते तदमलं छत्रं व्यजनं क्व च पार्थिव ।
सा च ते महती सेना क्व गता पार्थिवोत्तम ॥१८॥
9.65.19: यद् वै लोकगुरुर्भूत्वा भवानेतां दशां गतः ॥१९॥
9.65.21: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा दुःखितस्य विशेषतः ।
9.65.22: कृपादीन् स तदा वीरान् सर्वानेव नराधिपः ॥२२॥
9.65.24: सोऽयं मां समनुप्राप्तः प्रत्यक्षं भवतां हि यः ।
9.65.26: उत्साहश्च कृतो नित्यं मया दिष्ट्या युयुत्सता ।
9.65.28: यदि वेदाः प्रमाणं वो जिता लोका मयाक्षयाः ॥२८॥
9.65.30: स मया समनुप्राप्तो नास्मि शोच्यः कथञ्चन ।
9.65.31: यतितं विजये नित्यं दैवं तु दुरतिक्रमम् ।
9.65.32: तूष्णीं बभूव राजेन्द्र रुजासौ विह्वलो भृशम् ।
9.65.33: स च क्रोधसमाविष्टः पाणौ पाणिं निपीड्य च ॥३३॥
9.65.34: पिता मे निहतः क्षुद्रैः सुनृशंसेन कर्मणा ॥३४॥
9.65.35: न तथा तेन तप्यामि यथा राजंस्त्वयाद्य वै ।
शृणु चेदं वचो मह्यं सत्येन वदतः प्रभो ॥३५॥
9.65.37: अनुज्ञां तु महाराज भवान् मे दातुमर्हति ॥३७॥
9.65.38: इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं द्रोणपुत्रस्य कौरवः ।
9.65.41: सैनापत्येन भद्रं ते मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम् ॥४१॥
9.65.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते शल्यपर्वणि गदापर्वणि अश्वत्थामसैनापत्याभिषेके पञ्चषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ॥६५॥

9.1.2: udīryamāṇaṁ ca balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājā suyodhanaḥ,
pāṇḍavaiḥ prāptakālaṁ ca kiṁ prāpadyata kauravaḥ ॥2॥
9.1.3: na hi tr̥pyāmi pūrveṣāṁ śr̥ṇvānaścaritaṁ mahat ॥3॥
9.1.4: tataḥ karṇe hate rājan dhārtarāṣṭraḥ suyodhanaḥ,
9.1.5: hā karṇa hā karṇa iti śocamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
9.1.7: sa daivaṁ balavanmatvā bhavitavyaṁ ca pārthivaḥ,
9.1.11: apasr̥tya hradaṁ ghoraṁ viveśa ripujād bhayāt ॥11॥
9.1.15: sa praviśya purīṁ sūto bhujāvucchritya duḥkhitaḥ,
9.1.16: ruroda ca naravyāghra hā rājanniti duḥkhitaḥ,
aho bata vinaṣṭāḥ sma nidhanena mahātmanaḥ ॥16॥
9.1.18: dr̥ṣṭvaiva ca pure rājañjanaḥ sarvaḥ sa sañjayam,
9.1.19: ruroda ca bhr̥śodvigno hā rājanniti visvaram,
9.1.21: tathā sa vihvalaḥ sūtaḥ praviśya nr̥patikṣayam ॥21॥
9.1.24: tameva cārthaṁ dhyāyantaṁ karṇasya nidhanaṁ prati,
9.1.27: saṁśaptakā hatāḥ sarve kāmbojāśca śakaiḥ saha,
9.1.29: rājāno rājaputrāśca sarve te nihatā nr̥pa,
duryodhano hato rājā yathoktaṁ pāṇḍavena ha ॥29॥
9.1.32: tava putrā hatāḥ sarve draupadeyāśca bhārata,
9.1.34: kiñciccheṣaṁ ca śibiraṁ tāvakānāṁ kr̥taṁ prabho,
9.1.36: te caiva bhrātaraḥ pañca vāsudevo’tha sātyakiḥ,
kr̥paśca kr̥tavarmā ca drauṇiśca jayatāṁ varaḥ ॥36॥
9.1.38: ete śeṣā mahārāja sarve’nye nidhanaṁ gatāḥ,
kālena nihataṁ sarvaṁ jagad vai bharatarṣabha ॥38॥
9.1.39: duryodhanaṁ vai purataḥ kr̥tvā vairaṁ ca bhārata,
9.1.42: patitāḥ sahasā bhūmau śrutvā krūraṁ vacastadā,
9.1.43: kr̥cchreṇa tu tato rājā dhr̥tarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ ॥43॥
9.1.44: labdhvā tu sa nr̥paḥ sañjñāṁ vepamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ॥44॥
9.1.45: udīkṣya ca diśaḥ sarvāḥ kṣattāraṁ vākyamabravīt,
9.1.46: evamuktvā tato bhūyo visañjño nipapāta ha ॥46॥
9.1.47: taṁ tathā patitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bāndhavā ye’sya kecana,
9.1.48: sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena pratyāśvasto narādhipaḥ,
9.1.50: tathā sarvāḥ striyaścaiva gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī,
9.1.51: gacchantu yoṣitaḥ sarvā gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī ॥51॥
9.1.52: tatheme suhr̥daḥ sarve bhrāmyate me mano bhr̥śam,
9.2.2: sadhūmamiva niḥśvasya karau dhunvan punaḥ punaḥ,
9.2.3: aho bata mahadduḥkhaṁ yadahaṁ pāṇḍavān raṇe,
9.2.4: yacchrutvā nihatān putrān dīryate na sahasradhā ॥4॥
9.2.5: hatān putrānaśeṣeṇa dīryate me bhr̥śaṁ manaḥ ॥5॥
9.2.9: tvayā hīno mahābāho kāṁ nu yāsyāmyahaṁ gatim ॥9॥
9.2.10: śeṣe vinihato bhūmau prākr̥taḥ kunr̥po yathā ॥10॥
9.2.11: andhaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ ca māṁ vīra vihāya kva nu yāsyasi ॥11॥
9.2.12: sā kr̥pā sā ca te prītiḥ kva sā rājan sumānitā,
9.2.13: ko nu māmutthitaṁ vīra tāta tāteti vakṣyati,
9.2.14: pariṣvajya ca māṁ kaṇṭhe snehena klinnalocanaḥ,
anuśādhīti kauravya tat sādhu vada me vacaḥ ॥14॥
9.2.15: bhūyasī mama pr̥thvīyaṁ yathā pārthasya no tathā ॥15॥
9.2.21: ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno rājasattama,
9.2.22: teṣāṁ madhye sthito yuddhe bhrātr̥bhiḥ parivāritaḥ,
9.2.23: sātyakiṁ kuntibhojaṁ ca rākṣasaṁ ca ghaṭotkacam ॥23॥
9.2.25: kiṁ punaḥ sahitā vīrāḥ kr̥tavairāśca pāṇḍavaiḥ,
9.2.26: yotsyante saha rājendra haniṣyanti ca tān mr̥dhe,
karṇa eko mayā sārdhaṁ nihaniṣyati pāṇḍavān ॥26॥
9.2.27: tato nr̥patayo vīrāḥ sthāsyanti mama śāsane,
yaśca teṣāṁ praṇetā vai vāsudevo mahābalaḥ ॥27॥
9.2.28: na sa saṁnahyate rājanniti māmabravīd vacaḥ,
tasyātha vadataḥ sūta bahuśo mama saṁnidhau ॥28॥
9.2.29: teṣāṁ madhye sthitā yatra hanyante mama putrakāḥ ॥29॥
9.2.42: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kr̥tāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ,
9.2.50: duryodhano hato yatra śalyaśca nihato yudhi ॥50॥
9.2.52: ekena samare yena hataṁ putraśataṁ mama,
9.2.56: bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā sūtaputraṁ ca ghātitam ॥56॥
9.2.57: yaṁ yaṁ senāpraṇetāraṁ yudhi kurvanti māmakāḥ ॥57॥
9.2.58: acireṇaiva kālena taṁ taṁ nighnanti pāṇḍavāḥ,
raṇamūrdhni hato bhīṣmaḥ paśyatāṁ vaḥ kirīṭinā ॥58॥
9.2.60: sa rājakānāṁ sarveṣāṁ paśyatāṁ vaḥ kirīṭinā,
9.2.61: kecinna samyak paśyanti mūḍhāḥ samyagavekṣya ca,
tadidaṁ mama mūḍhasya tathābhūtaṁ vacaḥ sma tat ॥61॥
9.2.63: anayasya phalaṁ tasya brūhi gāvalgaṇe punaḥ ॥63॥
9.2.64: arjunaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca ko vā pratyudyayau rathī ॥64॥
9.2.65: vāmaṁ ca yoddhukāmasya ke vā vīrasya pr̥ṣṭhataḥ ॥65॥
9.2.66: kathaṁ ca vaḥ sametānāṁ madrarājo mahārathaḥ,
nihataḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saṅkhye putro vā mama sañjaya ॥66॥
9.2.67: yathā ca nihataḥ saṅkhye putro duryodhano mama ॥67॥
9.2.68: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca draupadyāḥ pañca cātmajāḥ ॥68॥
9.2.70: yad yathā yādr̥śaṁ caiva yuddhaṁ vr̥ttaṁ ca sāmpratam,
9.3.4: tadā tava sutān rājan prāviśat sumahad bhayam,
9.3.5: āsīd buddhirhate karṇe tava yodhasya kasyacit,
9.3.16: duryodhano’tha svaṁ sūtaṁ hā hā kr̥tvaivamabravīt,
9.3.17: samare yuddhyamānaṁ hi kaunteyo māṁ dhanañjayaḥ ॥17॥
9.3.24: na tān rathastho bhūmiṣṭhān dharmāpekṣī vr̥kodaraḥ ॥24॥
9.3.28: śyenavad vyacarad bhīmaḥ khaḍgena gadayā tathā ॥28॥
9.3.33: viśrutaṁ triṣu lokeṣu gāṇḍīvaṁ vyākṣipan dhanuḥ ॥33॥
9.3.34: arjunaṁ cāpi yoddhāraṁ tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥34॥
9.3.38: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥38॥
9.3.41: te sarve tāvakān prekṣya dravato vai parāṅmukhān,
9.3.42: senāvaśeṣaṁ taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava putrasya pāṇḍavaḥ,
9.3.43: tata enaṁ śarai rājan sahasā samavākirat,
rajasā codgatenātha na sma kiñcana dr̥śyate ॥43॥
9.3.44: diśaḥ sarvā mahārāja tāvakāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥44॥
9.3.51: na taṁ deśaṁ prapaśyāmi pr̥thivyāṁ parvateṣu ca ॥51॥
9.3.52: yatra yātānna vo hanyuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kiṁ sr̥tena vaḥ,
svalpaṁ caiva balaṁ teṣāṁ kr̥ṣṇau ca bhr̥śavikṣatau ॥52॥
9.3.53: yadi sarve’tra tiṣṭhāmo dhruvaṁ no vijayo bhavet,
9.3.54: anusr̥tya haniṣyanti śreyo naḥ samare vadhaḥ,
9.3.55: mr̥to duḥkhaṁ na jānīte pretya cānantyamaśnute,
9.3.57: na yuddhadharmācchreyān hi panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ ॥57॥
9.3.58: tasya tad vacanaṁ rājñaḥ pūjayitvā mahārathāḥ ॥58॥
9.4.1: raṇe ca nihatān nāgān dr̥ṣṭvā pattīṁśca māriṣa ॥1॥
9.4.7: duryodhana nibodhedaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi kaurava,
śrutvā kuru mahārāja yadi te rocate’nagha ॥7॥
9.4.8: na yuddhadharmācchreyān vai panthā rājendra vidyate,
9.4.9: putro bhrātā pitā caiva svasrīyo mātulastathā,
9.4.10: te sma ghorāṁ samāpannā jīvikāṁ jīvitārthinaḥ ॥10॥
9.4.11: hate bhīṣme ca droṇe ca karṇe caiva mahārathe ॥11॥
9.4.12: jayadrathe ca nihate tava bhrātr̥ṣu cānagha,
lakṣmaṇe tava putre ca kiṁ śeṣaṁ paryupāsmahe ॥12॥
9.4.13: te santyajya tanūryātāḥ śūrā brahmavidāṁ gatim ॥13॥
9.4.17: gāṇḍīvasya ca nirghoṣāt sammuhyante manāṁsi naḥ ॥17॥
9.4.20: pibanta iva cākāśaṁ rathe yuktāstu vājinaḥ ॥20॥
9.4.24: vikṣobhayantaṁ senāṁ te trāsayantaṁ ca pārthivān,
9.4.30: kva nu te sūtaputro’bhūt kva nu droṇaḥ sahānugaḥ,
ahaṁ kva ca kva cātmā te hārdikyaśca tathā kva nu ॥30॥
9.4.31: duḥśāsanaśca te bhrātā bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaḥ kva nu,
9.4.33: jayadratho hato rājan kiṁ nu śeṣamupāsmahe,
ko hīha sa pumānasti yo vijeṣyati pāṇḍavam ॥33॥
9.4.34: gāṇḍīvasya ca nirghoṣo dhairyāṇi harate hi naḥ ॥34॥
9.4.38: uvāca vākyaṁ yad bhīmaḥ sabhāmadhye viśāmpate,
kr̥taṁ tat saphalaṁ tena bhūyaścaiva kariṣyati ॥38॥
9.4.41: ātmano’rthe tvayā loko yatnataḥ sarva āhr̥taḥ,
sa te saṁśāyitastāta ātmā vai bharatarṣabha ॥41॥
9.4.42: bhinne hi bhājane tāta diśo gacchati tadgatam ॥42॥
9.4.43: hīyamānena vai sandhiḥ paryeṣṭavyaḥ samena vā,
9.4.44: te vayaṁ pāṇḍuputrebhyo hīnā sma balaśaktitaḥ,
tadatra pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ sandhiṁ manye kṣamaṁ prabho ॥44॥
9.4.45: na jānīte hi yaḥ śreyaḥ śreyasaścāvamanyate,
sa kṣipraṁ bhraśyate rājyānna ca śreyo’nuvindate ॥45॥
9.4.46: praṇipatya hi rājānaṁ rājyaṁ yadi labhemahi,
śreyaḥ syānna tu mauḍhyena rājan gantuḥ parābhavam ॥46॥
9.4.50: etat kṣemamahaṁ manye na ca pārthaiśca vigraham,
9.4.51: pathyaṁ rājan bravīmi tvāṁ tatparāsuḥ smariṣyasi,
iti vr̥ddho vilapyaitat kr̥paḥ śāradvato vacaḥ,
dīrghamuṣṇaṁ ca niḥśvasya śuśoca ca mumoha ca ॥51॥
9.5.2: tato muhūrtaṁ sa dhyātvā dhārtarāṣṭro mahāmanāḥ,
9.5.3: yat kiñcit suhr̥dā vācyaṁ tat sarvaṁ śrāvito hyaham,
kr̥taṁ ca bhavatā sarvaṁ prāṇān santyajya yudhyatā ॥3॥
9.5.5: suhr̥dā yadidaṁ vākyaṁ bhavatā śrāvito hyaham,
na māṁ prīṇāti tat sarvaṁ mumūrṣoriva bheṣajam ॥5॥
9.5.6: ucyamānaṁ mahābāho na me viprāgrya rocate ॥6॥
9.5.8: sa kathaṁ mama vākyāni śraddadhyād bhūya eva tu,
tathā dautyena samprāptaḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ pārthahite rataḥ ॥8॥
9.5.9: sa ca me vacanaṁ brahman kathamevābhimanyate ॥9॥
9.5.10: vilalāpa ca yat kr̥ṣṇā sabhāmadhye sameyuṣī,
na tanmarṣayate kr̥ṣṇo na rājyaharaṇaṁ tathā ॥10॥
9.5.12: svasrīyaṁ nihataṁ śrutvā duḥkhaṁ svapiti keśavaḥ,
kr̥tāgaso vayaṁ tasya sa madarthaṁ kathaṁ kṣamet ॥12॥
9.5.13: sa kathaṁ maddhite yatnaṁ prakariṣyati yācitaḥ ॥13॥
9.5.14: pratijñātaṁ ca tenograṁ bhajyetāpi na saṁnamet ॥14॥
9.5.16: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca kr̥tavairau mayā saha,
tau kathaṁ maddhite yatnaṁ kuryātāṁ dvijasattama ॥16॥
9.5.19: yadā ca draupadī kliṣṭā madvināśāya duḥkhitā,
sthaṇḍile nityadā śete yāvad vairasya yātanam ॥19॥
9.5.21: kr̥ṣṇāyāḥ preṣyavad bhūtvā śuśrūṣāṁ kurute sadā,
iti sarvaṁ samunnaddhaṁ na nirvāti kathañcana ॥21॥
9.5.22: kathaṁ ca rājā bhuktvemāṁ pr̥thivīṁ sāgarāmbarām ॥22॥
9.5.23: uparyupari rājñāṁ vai jvalitvā bhāskaro yathā ॥23॥
9.5.24: kathaṁ bhuktvā svayaṁ bhogān dattvā dāyāṁśca puṣkalān ॥24॥
9.5.25: nābhyasūyāmi te vākyamuktaṁ snigdhaṁ hitaṁ tvayā ॥25॥
9.5.26: na tu sandhimahaṁ manye prāptakālaṁ kathañcana,
9.5.27: nāyaṁ klībayituṁ kālaḥ saṁyoddhuṁ kāla eva naḥ,
9.5.28: prāptāḥ kāmāḥ śrutā vedāḥ śatrūṇāṁ mūrdhni ca sthitam,
9.5.31: na dhruvaṁ sukhamastīti kuto rāṣṭraṁ kuto yaśaḥ,
iha kīrtirvidhātavyā sā ca yuddhena nānyathā ॥31॥
9.5.32: gr̥he yat kṣatriyasyāpi nidhanaṁ tad vigarhitam,
9.5.33: araṇye yo vimucyeta saṅgrāme vā tanuṁ naraḥ,
9.5.34: mriyate rudatāṁ madhye jñātīnāṁ na sa pūruṣaḥ ॥34॥
9.5.35: tyaktvā tu vividhān bhogān prāptānāṁ paramāṁ gatim,
9.5.37: mudā nūnaṁ prapaśyanti yuddhe hyapsarasāṁ gaṇāḥ ॥37॥
9.5.43: taiḥ svayaṁ racito mārgo durgamo hi punarbhavet,
9.5.44: r̥ṇaṁ tat pratiyuñjāno na rājye mana ādadhe ॥44॥
9.5.45: jīvitaṁ yadi rakṣeyaṁ loko māṁ garhayed dhruvam ॥45॥
9.5.46: kīdr̥śaṁ ca bhaved rājyaṁ mama hīnasya bandhubhiḥ,
9.5.47: suyuddhena tataḥ svargaṁ prāpsyāmi na tadanyathā ॥47॥
9.5.51: ākāśe vidrume puṇye prasthe himavataḥ śubhe,
aruṇāṁ sarasvatīṁ prāpya papuḥ sasnuśca te jalam ॥51॥
9.6.4: raṇe karṇe hate vīre trāsitā jitakāśibhiḥ,
nālabhan śarma te putrā himavantamr̥te girim ॥4॥
9.6.12: smr̥tvā smr̥tvaiva tu guṇān dhātrā yatnād vinirmitam ॥12॥
9.6.17: yaṁ puraskr̥tya sahitā yudhi jeṣyāma pāṇḍavān ॥17॥
9.6.19: ayaṁ kulena rūpeṇa tejasā yaśasā śriyā,
9.6.23: yuddhāya ca matiṁ cakrurāveśaṁ ca paraṁ yayuḥ,
tato duryodhano bhūmau sthitvā rathavare sthitam ॥23॥
9.6.24: ayaṁ sa kālaḥ samprāpto mitrāṇāṁ mitravatsala ॥24॥
9.6.25: yatra mitramamitraṁ vā parīkṣante budhā janāḥ,
sa bhavānastu naḥ śūraḥ praṇetā vāhinīmukhe ॥25॥
9.6.26: raṇaṁ yāte ca bhavati pāṇḍavā mandacetasaḥ,
9.6.28: yattu māṁ manyase rājan kururāja karomi tat,
tvatpriyārthaṁ hi me sarvaṁ prāṇā rājyaṁ dhanāni ca ॥28॥
9.6.29: so’smān pāhi yudhāṁ śreṣṭha skando devānivāhave ॥29॥
9.6.30: jahi śatrūn raṇe vīra mahendro dānavāniva ॥30॥
9.7.2: yāvetau manyase kr̥ṣṇau rathasthau rathināṁ varau ॥2॥
9.7.5: ahaṁ senāpraṇetā te bhaviṣyāmi na saṁśayaḥ,
taṁ ca vyūhaṁ vidhāsyāmi na tariṣyanti yaṁ pare ॥5॥
9.7.6: iti satyaṁ bravīmyeṣa duryodhana na saṁśayaḥ,
9.7.11: tvaṁ hi śakto raṇe jetuṁ sasurāsuramānavān ॥11॥
9.7.13: adya cāhaṁ raṇe sarvān pañcālān saha pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥13॥
9.7.14: nihaniṣyāmi vā rājan svargaṁ yāsyāmi vā hataḥ,
9.7.16: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca sarve cāpi prabhadrakāḥ,
vikramaṁ mama paśyantu dhanuṣaśca mahad balam ॥16॥
9.7.17: lāghavaṁ cāstravīryaṁ ca bhujayośca balaṁ yudhi,
adya paśyantu me pārthāḥ siddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ ॥17॥
9.7.18: yādr̥śaṁ me balaṁ bāhvoḥ sampadastreṣu yā ca me,
adya me vikramaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathāḥ ॥18॥
9.7.20: vicariṣye raṇe yudhyan priyārthaṁ tava kaurava ॥20॥
9.7.21: abhiṣikte tathā śalye tava sainyeṣu mānada,
9.7.23: praharṣaṁ prāpya senā tu tāvakī bharatarṣabha,
tāṁ rātrimuṣitā suptā harṣacittā ca sābhavat ॥23॥
9.7.24: sainyasya tava taṁ śabdaṁ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
9.7.26: bhavān netā ca goptā ca vidhatsva yadanantaram ॥26॥
9.7.28: kr̥tī ca citrayodhī ca saṁyukto lāghavena ca ॥28॥
9.7.29: yādr̥g bhīṣmastathā droṇo yādr̥k karṇaśca saṁyuge,
9.7.34: madrarājaṁ raṇe kruddhaṁ yo hanyāt kurunandana ॥34॥
9.7.36: tavaiva hi jayo nūnaṁ hate madreśvare yudhi ॥36॥
9.7.37: tasmin hate hataṁ sarvaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrabalaṁ mahat,
9.7.38: jahi cainaṁ mahābāho vāsavo namuciṁ yathā ॥38॥
9.7.39: na caivātra dayā kāryā mātulo’yaṁ mameti vai,
9.7.41: yacca te tapaso vīryaṁ yacca kṣātraṁ balaṁ tava,
tad darśaya raṇe sarvaṁ jahi cainaṁ mahāratham ॥41॥
9.7.43: keśave tu tadā yāte dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
9.7.44: suṣvāpa rajanīṁ tāṁ tu viśalya iva kuñjaraḥ,
te ca sarve maheṣvāsāḥ pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavāstathā ॥44॥
9.7.45: karṇasya nidhane hr̥ṣṭāḥ suṣupustāṁ niśāṁ tadā,
9.7.46: babhūva pāṇḍaveyānāṁ sainyaṁ ca muditaṁ nr̥pa,
sūtaputrasya nidhane jayaṁ labdhvā ca māriṣa ॥46॥
9.8.7: tataḥ sarve samāgamya putreṇa tava sainikāḥ,
kr̥paśca kr̥tavarmā ca drauṇiḥ śalyo’tha saubalaḥ ॥7॥
9.8.8: anye ca pārthivāḥ śeṣāḥ samayaṁ cakrurādr̥tāḥ,
na na ekena yoddhavyaṁ kathañcidapi pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥8॥
9.8.9: yo hyekaḥ pāṇḍavairyudhyed yo vā yudhyantamutsr̥jet,
9.8.10: evaṁ te samayaṁ kr̥tvā sarve tatra mahārathāḥ ॥10॥
9.8.11: tathaiva pāṇḍavā rājan vyūhya sainyaṁ mahāraṇe ॥11॥
9.8.13: droṇasya caiva bhīṣmasya rādheyasya ca me śrutam ॥13॥
9.8.14: pātanaṁ śaṁsa me bhūyaḥ śalyasyātha sutasya me,
kathaṁ raṇe hataḥ śalyo dharmarājena sañjaya ॥14॥
9.8.15: bhīmena ca mahābāhuḥ putro duryodhano mama,
9.8.16: śr̥ṇu rājan sthiro bhūtvā saṅgrāmaṁ śaṁsato mama,
9.8.17: hate droṇe ca bhīṣme ca sūtaputre ca pātite,
śalyaḥ pārthān raṇe sarvān nihaniṣyati māriṣa ॥17॥
9.8.18: tāmāśāṁ hr̥daye kr̥tvā samāśvasya ca bhārata,
9.8.19: yadā karṇe hate pārthāḥ siṁhanādaṁ pracakrire ॥19॥
9.8.20: tadā tu tāvakān rājannāviveśa mahad bhayam,
9.8.24: tasthau śūro mahārāja putrāṇāṁ te bhayapraṇut,
9.8.26: gautamo dakṣiṇe pārśve śakaiśca yavanaiḥ saha,
9.8.35: hate bhīṣme maheṣvāse droṇe karṇe mahārathe ॥35॥
9.8.37: māmakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca kiṁ śiṣṭamabhavad balam,
yathā vayaṁ pare rājan yuddhāya samupasthitāḥ ॥37॥
9.8.38: yāvaccāsīd balaṁ śiṣṭaṁ saṅgrāme tannibodha me,
9.8.39: daśa dantisahasrāṇi sapta caiva śatāni ca,
pūrṇe śatasahasre dve hayānāṁ tatra bhārata ॥39॥
9.8.45: upayātā naravyāghrāḥ pūrvāṁ sandhyāṁ prati prabho,
9.9.9: tathā ca rathinaṁ kruddhaṁ vikirantaṁ śarān bahūn,
9.9.10: nāgo nāgamabhidrutya rathī ca rathinaṁ raṇe,
9.9.12: haṁsā himavataḥ prasthe pibanta iva medinīm ॥12॥
9.9.13: teṣāṁ tu vājināṁ bhūmiḥ khuraiścitrā viśāmpate,
9.9.14: pattīnāṁ cāpi śabdena nāgānāṁ br̥ṁhitena ca ॥14॥
9.9.15: vāditrāṇāṁ ca ghoṣeṇa śaṅkhānāṁ ninadena ca,
9.9.26: vyadīryata diśaḥ sarvā vātanunnā ghanā iva ॥26॥
9.9.37: sā vadhyamānā mahatī senā tava narādhipa,
9.9.43: vadhyamānā camūḥ sā tu putrāṇāṁ prekṣatāṁ tava,
9.9.46: tyaktvā yuddhe priyān putrān bhrātr̥̄natha pitāmahān,
9.10.1: tat prabhagnaṁ balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā madrarājaḥ pratāpavān,
9.10.2: eṣa tiṣṭhati vai rājā pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
9.10.3: atra māṁ prāpaya kṣipraṁ paśya me sārathe balam,
na samartho hi me pārthaḥ sthātumadya puro yudhi ॥3॥
9.10.5: prāpatat tacca sahasā pāṇḍavānāṁ mahad balam,
9.10.7: madrarājaṁ tu samare dr̥ṣṭvā yuddhāya dhiṣṭhitam,
9.10.16: sa cchinnadhanvā virathaḥ khaḍgamādāya carma ca ॥16॥
9.10.21: citrasenaṁ viśastaṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā tatra mahārathāḥ,
9.10.23: jighāṁsantau yathā nāgaṁ vyāghrau rājan mahāvane ॥23॥
9.10.25: sa śaraiḥ sarvato viddhaḥ prahr̥ṣṭa iva pāṇḍavaḥ,
9.10.26: tasya tau bhrātarau rājan śaraiḥ saṁnataparvabhiḥ ॥26॥
9.10.31: suṣeṇastu tataḥ kruddhaḥ pāṇḍavasya mahad dhanuḥ ॥31॥
9.10.35: saṁnivārya tu tān bāṇān nakulaḥ paravīrahā ॥35॥
9.10.40: sā tasya hr̥dayaṁ saṅkhye bibheda ca tathā nr̥pa ॥40॥
9.10.42: caturbhiścaturo vāhān dhvajaṁ chittvā ca pañcabhiḥ ॥42॥
9.10.43: tribhirvai sārathiṁ hatvā karṇaputro nanāda ha,
9.10.51: sa hataḥ prāpatad rājan nakulena mahātmanā,
9.10.53: tāṁ tu senāṁ mahārāja madrarājaḥ pratāpavān,
9.10.54: siṁhanādaṁ bhr̥śaṁ kr̥tvā dhanuḥśabdaṁ ca dāruṇam ॥54॥
9.10.60: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca mr̥tyuṁ kr̥tvā nivartanam ॥60॥
9.10.62: tataḥ kapidhvajo rājan hatvā saṁśaptakān raṇe,
9.10.63: abhyadhāvanta tāṁ senāṁ visr̥jantaḥ śitān śarān ॥63॥
9.10.64: na ca jajñustvanīkāni diśo vā vidiśastathā ॥64॥
9.10.66: tathaiva pāṇḍavaṁ sainyaṁ śarai rājan samantataḥ ॥66॥
9.11.10: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sīdatīṁ senāṁ paṅke gāmiva durbalām,
9.11.14: cacāla śabdaṁ kurvāṇā mahī cāpi saparvatā ॥14॥
9.11.16: apasavyaṁ tadā cakruḥ senāṁ te bahuśo nr̥pa ॥16॥
9.11.25: hrādinya iva meghebhyaḥ śalyasya nyapatan śarāḥ ॥25॥
9.11.27: āviṣṭa iva madreśo manyunā pauruṣeṇa ca,
9.11.29: tāṁ sammardya tataḥ saṅkhye laghuhastaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥29॥
9.11.32: tato vr̥kodaraḥ kruddhaḥ śalyaṁ vivyādha saptabhiḥ ॥32॥
9.11.34: tato dr̥ṣṭvā vāryamāṇaṁ śalyaṁ pārthaiḥ samantataḥ ॥34॥
9.11.49: tasya bhīmo raṇe kruddhaḥ sandaśya daśanacchadam,
9.11.56: jaghāna guhyakān kruddho nadan pārtho mahābalaḥ ॥56॥
9.11.59: tataḥ śalyo raṇe kruddhaḥ pīne vakṣasi tomaram ॥59॥
9.11.60: nicakhāna nadan vīro varma bhittvā ca so’bhyayāt,
9.12.1: patitaṁ prekṣya yantāraṁ śalyaḥ sarvāyasīṁ gadām,
9.12.6: na hi madrādhipādanyo rāmād vā yadunandanāt,
9.12.13: tathā bhīmena śalyasya tāḍitā gadayā gadā,
9.12.17: śalyo na vivyathe rājan dantineva mahāgiriḥ ॥17॥
9.12.28: bhujāvucchritya śastraṁ ca śabdena mahatā tataḥ ॥28॥
9.12.31: prāsena cekitānaṁ vai vivyādha hr̥daye bhr̥śam,
sa papāta rathopasthe tava putreṇa tāḍitaḥ ॥31॥
9.12.38: prāviśaṁstāvakā rājan haṁsā iva mahat saraḥ,
9.12.43: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca nāsīt kaścit parāṅmukhaḥ,
9.12.47: iti sma vācaḥ śrūyante tava teṣāṁ ca vai bale,
9.12.48: tasya pārtho mahārāja nārācān vai caturdaśa ॥48॥
9.12.52: candrasenaṁ ca saptatyā sūtaṁ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥52॥
9.12.57: pāṇḍuputreṇa vai tasya ketuṁ chinnaṁ mahātmanā ॥57॥
9.12.58: dhvajaṁ nipatitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavaṁ ca vyavasthitam ॥58॥
9.12.60: sātyakiṁ bhīmasenaṁ ca mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥60॥
9.12.62: tasya śalyo raṇe kruddhaḥ śaraiḥ saṁnataparvabhiḥ ॥62॥
9.13.6: viddhvā taṁ tu punastūrṇaṁ tato vivyādha saptabhiḥ ॥6॥
9.13.7: sa tu śūro raṇe yattaḥ pīḍitastairmahārathaiḥ,
9.13.14: tāṁśca sarvān maheṣvāsān pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥14॥
9.13.19: sa sātyakeḥ praciccheda kṣurapreṇa mahad dhanuḥ ॥19॥
9.13.22: nakulaḥ samare śaktiṁ sahadevo gadāṁ śubhām,
9.13.26: śarābhyāṁ ca śataghnīṁ tāṁ rājñaściccheda bhārata ॥26॥
9.13.28: dvābhyāṁ madreśvaraṁ viddhvā sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥28॥
9.13.29: tataḥ śalyo raṇe rājan sarvāṁstān daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.13.30: na śekuḥ sammukhe sthātuṁ tasya śatruniṣūdanāḥ ॥30॥
9.13.31: tato duryodhano rājā dr̥ṣṭvā śalyasya vikramam,
9.13.33: parivārya tadā śalyaṁ samantād vyakiran śaraiḥ ॥33॥
9.13.38: kathaṁ nu samare śakyaṁ tanmādhavavaco mahat,
na hi kruddho raṇe rājā kṣapayeta balaṁ mama ॥38॥
9.13.38d1: pañcālāḥ sr̥ñjayāścaiva na śaktāḥ sma hi madrapam.
9.13.38d2: govindavacanaṁ satyaṁ kathaṁ bhavati kiṁ tvidam.
9.13.42: sampatantaḥ sma dr̥śyante śalabhānāṁ vrajā iva ॥42॥
9.13.44: na pāṇḍavānāṁ nāsmākaṁ tatra kiñcid vyadr̥śyata,
9.13.45: cālyamānaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavānāṁ balārṇavam ॥45॥
9.13.46: sa tu tān sarvato yattān śaraiḥ sañchādya māriṣa ॥46॥
9.13.47: te cchannāḥ samare tena pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathāḥ ॥47॥
9.14.4: na jahuḥ pārthamāsādya tāḍyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.14.7: kūbaraṁ rathacakrāṇi īṣā yoktrāṇi vā vibho ॥7॥
9.14.8: naitādr̥śaṁ dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ rājan naiva ca na śrutam ॥8॥
9.14.9: sa rathaḥ sarvato bhāti citrapuṅkhaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥9॥
9.14.13: cakrāṇāṁ patatāṁ cāpi yugānāṁ ca dharātale ॥13॥
9.14.14: tūṇīrāṇāṁ patākānāṁ dhvajānāṁ ca rathaiḥ saha,
9.14.16: bhujānāṁ ca mahābhāga skandhānāṁ ca samantataḥ,
chatrāṇāṁ vyajanaiḥ sārdhaṁ mukuṭānāṁ ca rāśayaḥ ॥16॥
9.14.19: hatvā tu samare pārthaḥ sahasre dve parantapaḥ ॥19॥
9.14.31: sa cchinnaṁ musalaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā drauṇiḥ paramakopanaḥ ॥31॥
9.14.36: nākampata tadā drauṇiḥ pauruṣe sve vyavasthitaḥ,
surathaṁ ca tato rājan bhāradvājo mahāratham ॥36॥
9.14.38: vikarṣan vai dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ sarvabhārasahaṁ dr̥ḍham ॥38॥
9.14.43: tataḥ sa patito bhūmau nārācena samāhataḥ,
vajreṇa ca yathā śr̥ṅgaṁ parvatasyeva dīryataḥ ॥43॥
9.14.44: āruroha rathaṁ tūrṇaṁ tameva rathināṁ varaḥ ॥44॥
9.15.3: rājā ca pārṣataṁ viddhvā śaraiḥ pañcabhirāśugaiḥ,
9.15.5: mahatyā senayā sārdhaṁ parivavruḥ sma pārṣatam ॥5॥
9.15.10: tathā tau tu yamau yuddhe yamatulyaparākramau,
9.15.19: sātyakiṁ ca śatenājau sahadevaṁ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.15.25: athāsya saśaraṁ cāpaṁ muṣṭau ciccheda māriṣa,
9.15.27: mādrīputrau ca saṁrabdhau bhīmasenaṁ ca pāṇḍavam,
yudhiṣṭhiraṁ ca kauravya vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥27॥
9.15.41: yadekaḥ samare śūro yodhayāmāsa vai bahūn ॥41॥
9.16.4: tato dhanañjayaḥ kruddhaḥ kr̥paṁ saha padānugaiḥ,
9.16.7: śalyaṁ tu saha sainyena kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥7॥
9.16.8: tataḥ samabhavat sainyaṁ saṁsaktaṁ tatra tatra ha,
9.16.12: tasya tallāghavaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tathaiva ca kr̥tāstratām,
9.16.16: samāhūyābravīt sarvān bhrātr̥̄n kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca mādhavam,
bhīṣmo droṇaśca karṇaśca ye cānye pr̥thivīkṣitaḥ ॥16॥
9.16.19: tatra yanmānasaṁ mahyaṁ tat sarvaṁ nigadāmi vaḥ,
9.16.21: māṁ vā śalyo raṇe hantā taṁ vāhaṁ bhadramastu vaḥ ॥21॥
9.16.27: tataḥ praharṣaḥ sainyānāṁ punarāsīt tadā mr̥dhe,
9.16.28: pratijñāṁ tāṁ tadā rājā kr̥tvā madreśamabhyayāt,
9.16.34: vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi citraṁ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca ॥34॥
9.16.35: na cāsya vivaraṁ kaścid dadarśa carato raṇe,
9.16.38: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca rājan durmantrite tava ॥38॥
9.16.42: sa cchinnadhanvā tejasvī rathaśaktyā sutaṁ tava,
9.16.45: kr̥paśca kr̥tavarmā ca putraṁ te’pi parīpsavaḥ ॥45॥
9.16.48: purā bhūtvā mr̥durdānto yat tadā dāruṇo’bhavat ॥48॥
9.16.50: yāṁ yāṁ pratyudyayau senāṁ tāṁ tāṁ jyeṣṭhaḥ sa pāṇḍavaḥ,
9.16.58: puṣpitau śuśubhāte vai vasante kiṁśukau yathā,
9.16.60: śalyo vā pāṇḍavaṁ hatvā dadyād duryodhanāya gām,
itīva niścayo nābhūd yodhānāṁ tatra bhārata ॥60॥
9.17.2: tataḥ sa śaravarṣeṇa parjanya iva vr̥ṣṭimān,
9.17.5: rathāṁśca rathinaḥ sārdhaṁ jaghāna rathināṁ varaḥ ॥5॥
9.17.6: cakāra ca mahīṁ yodhaistīrṇāṁ vedīṁ kuśairiva ॥6॥
9.17.52: prasārya bāhū ca rathād gato gāṁ
9.17.54: pratyudgata iva premṇā bhūmyā sa narapuṅgavaḥ ॥54॥
9.17.55: ciraṁ bhuktvā vasumatīṁ priyāṁ kāntāmiva prabhuḥ ॥55॥
9.17.64: kārmukaṁ cāsya ciccheda kṣurābhyāṁ dhvajameva ca,
9.17.65: sakuṇḍalaṁ tad dadr̥śe patamānaṁ śiro rathāt ॥65॥
9.17.77: tato rathaṁ yugeṣāṁ ca cchittvā bhallaiḥ susaṁyataiḥ ॥77॥
9.17.78: tatastaṁ virathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥paḥ śāradvataḥ prabho ॥78॥
9.17.80: tat pare nānvabudhyanta sainyena rajasā vr̥te ॥80॥
9.17.81: balaṁ tu hatabhūyiṣṭhaṁ tat tadā’’sīt parāṅmukham,
tato muhūrtāt te’paśyan rajo bhīmaṁ samutthitam ॥81॥
9.17.83: pāṇḍavān sarathān dr̥ṣṭvā dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pārṣatam ॥83॥
9.17.89: tava durmantrite rājan saha putrasya bhārata ॥89॥
9.18.3: duryodhanena te vīrā vāryamāṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥3॥
9.18.4: te tu śūrā mahārāja kr̥tacittāśca yodhane ॥4॥
9.18.5: śrutvā ca nihataṁ śalyaṁ dharmaputraṁ ca pīḍitam ॥5॥
9.18.6: ājagāma tataḥ pārtho gāṇḍīvaṁ vikṣipan dhanuḥ ॥6॥
9.18.8: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca pañcālāḥ saha somakaiḥ ॥8॥
9.18.10: kṣobhayanti sma tāṁ senāṁ makarāḥ sāgaraṁ yathā,
9.18.11: akṣobhyata tadā rājan pāṇḍūnāṁ dhvajinī tataḥ ॥11॥
9.18.13: bhrātaro vāsya te śūrā dr̥śyane neha kena ca,
9.18.14: evaṁ tān vādinaḥ śūrān draupadeyā mahārathāḥ ॥14॥
9.18.16: te dr̥śyante’pi samare tāvakā nihatāḥ paraiḥ,
ālokya pāṇḍavān yuddhe yodhā rājan samantataḥ ॥16॥
9.18.19: kiṁ naḥ samprekṣamāṇānāṁ madrāṇāṁ hanyate balam ॥19॥
9.18.20: na yuktametat samare tvayi tiṣṭhati bhārata,
9.18.21: atha kasmāt parāneva ghnato marṣayase nr̥pa,
vāryamāṇā mayā pūrvaṁ naite cakrurvaco mama ॥21॥
9.18.22: na bhartuḥ śāsanaṁ vīrā raṇe kurvantyamarṣitāḥ ॥22॥
9.18.28: te muhūrtād raṇe vīrā hastāhasti viśāmpate ॥28॥
9.18.34: tatra tatra vyadr̥śyanta yoktraiḥ śliṣṭāḥ sma vājinaḥ ॥34॥
9.18.39: madrarājaṁ ca samare dr̥ṣṭvā śūraṁ nipātitam ॥39॥
9.19.4: vr̥ṣā yathā bhagnaśr̥ṅgāḥ śīrṇadantā yathā gajāḥ,
9.19.5: na sandhātumanīkāni na ca rājan parākrame,
āsīd buddhirhate śalye bhūyo yodhasya kasyacit ॥5॥
9.19.6: bhīṣme droṇe ca nihate sūtaputre ca bhārata,
yad duḥkhaṁ tava yodhānāṁ bhayaṁ cāsīd viśāmpate ॥6॥
9.19.7: tad bhayaṁ sa ca naḥ śoko bhaya evābhyavartata,
nirāśāśca jaye tasmin hate śalye mahārathe ॥7॥
9.19.8: madrarāje hate rājan yodhāste prādravan bhayāt ॥8॥
9.19.11: te raṇād bharataśreṣṭha tāvakāḥ prādravan diśaḥ,
9.19.12: tān prabhagnān drutān dr̥ṣṭvā hatotsāhān parājitān,
9.19.14: dr̥ṣṭvā tu kauravaṁ sainyaṁ bhayatrastaṁ pravidrutam,
9.19.16: adya śrutvā hataṁ putraṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ,
9.19.18: adya kṣatturvacaḥ satyaṁ smaratāṁ bruvato hitam,
9.19.19: vijānātu nr̥po duḥkhaṁ yat prāptaṁ pāṇḍunandanaiḥ,
9.19.20: astrāṇāṁ ca balaṁ sarvaṁ bāhvośca balamāhave ॥20॥
9.19.21: adya jñāsyati bhīmasya balaṁ ghoraṁ mahātmanaḥ,
9.19.24: nihate saubale vīre pravīreṣu ca sarvaśaḥ ॥24॥
9.19.25: kathaṁ jayo na teṣāṁ syād yeṣāṁ yoddhā dhanañjayaḥ,
9.19.26: śikhaṇḍī ca maheṣvāso rājā caiva yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥26॥
9.19.27: yeṣāṁ ca jagatīnātho nāthaḥ kr̥ṣṇo janārdanaḥ,
kathaṁ teṣāṁ jayo na syād yeṣāṁ dharmo vyapāśrayaḥ ॥27॥
9.19.28: bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ ca karṇaṁ ca madrarājānameva ca,
9.19.29: ko’nyaḥ śakto raṇe jetumr̥te pārthād yudhiṣṭhirāt,
9.19.34: jaghane yudhyamānaṁ hi kaunteyo māṁ samantataḥ,
9.19.35: paśya sainyaṁ mahat sūta pāṇḍavaiḥ samabhidrutam,
9.19.36: tasmād yāhi śanaiḥ sūta jaghanaṁ paripālaya ॥36॥
9.19.37: mayi sthite ca samare niruddheṣu ca pāṇḍuṣu,
9.19.46: na cacāla tataḥ sthānānmaināka iva parvataḥ,
te tu kruddhā mahārāja pāṇḍavasya mahāratham ॥46॥
9.19.55: te sarvaṁ tāvakān dr̥ṣṭvā maheṣvāsāḥ parāṅmukhān ॥55॥
9.19.58: na taṁ deśaṁ prapaśyāmi pr̥thivyāṁ parvateṣu ca ॥58॥
9.19.59: yatra yātānna vā hanyuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kiṁ sr̥tena vaḥ,
alpaṁ ca balameteṣāṁ kr̥ṣṇau ca bhr̥śavikṣatau ॥59॥
9.19.60: yadi sarve’tra tiṣṭhāmo dhruvaṁ no vijayo bhavet,
9.19.62: yadā śūraṁ ca bhīruṁ ca mārayatyantakaḥ sadā,
ko nu mūḍho na yudhyeta puruṣaḥ kṣatriyo dhruvam ॥62॥
9.19.65: hatveha sukhamāpnoti hataḥ pretya mahat phalam,
na yuddhadharmācchreyān vai panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ ॥65॥
9.19.66: śrutvā tad vacanaṁ tasya pūjayitvā ca pārthivāḥ ॥66॥
9.19.69: viśrutaṁ triṣu lokeṣu vyākṣipan gāṇḍivaṁ dhanuḥ,
9.19.70: javenābhyapatan hr̥ṣṭā yattā vai tāvakaṁ balam ॥70॥
9.21.2: tat prabhagnaṁ balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥tavarmā mahārathaḥ,
9.21.4: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
9.21.10: sātvatau ca mahāvīryau dhanvinau rathināṁ varau,
9.21.19: āropya ca dhanuḥ śīghraṁ mahāvīryo mahābalaḥ ॥19॥
9.21.21: jaghāna sūtaṁ cāśvāṁśca dhvajaṁ ca kr̥tavarmaṇaḥ ॥21॥
9.21.24: tacchūlaṁ sātvato hyājau nirbhidya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.21.31: tat pare nānvabudhyanta sainyena rajasā vr̥tāḥ ॥31॥
9.21.33: pāṇḍūṁśca sarvān saṅkruddho dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pārṣatam ॥33॥
9.21.34: śikhaṇḍinaṁ draupadeyān pañcālānāṁ ca ye gaṇāḥ,
9.22.1: putrastu te mahārāja rathastho rathināṁ varaḥ,
durutsaho babhau yuddhe yathā rudraḥ pratāpavān ॥1॥
9.22.3: na ca so’sti pumān kaścit pāṇḍavānāṁ balārṇave,
hayo gajo ratho vāpi yaḥ syād bāṇairavikṣataḥ ॥3॥
9.22.4: yaṁ yaṁ hi samare yodhaṁ prapaśyāmi viśāmpate,
sa sa bāṇaiścito’bhūd vai putreṇa tava bhārata ॥4॥
9.22.9: bhīmasenaṁ ca saptatyā sahadevaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ ॥9॥
9.22.10: nakulaṁ ca catuḥṣaṣṭyā dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
9.22.12: tato duryodhanaṁ saṅkhye vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥12॥
9.22.13: nakulastu tato vīro rājānaṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.22.16: lāghavaṁ sauṣṭhavaṁ cāpi vīryaṁ cāpi mahātmanaḥ ॥16॥
9.22.19: kṣubdhasya hi samudrasya prāvr̥ṭkāle yathā svanaḥ,
9.22.21: nājñāyanta raṇe vīrā na diśaḥ pradiśaḥ kutaḥ ॥21॥
9.22.29: tathaiva nakulaḥ śūraḥ saubalasya sutaṁ raṇe ॥29॥
9.22.30: tau tatra samare vīrau kulaputrau mahārathau ॥30॥
9.22.32: yodhayan śuśubhe rājan baliṁ śakra ivāhave,
9.22.38: sa ca tān prati saṁrabdhaḥ pratyayodhayadāhave,
evaṁ citramabhūd yuddhaṁ tasya taiḥ saha bhārata ॥38॥
9.22.40: hayā hayaiḥ samāsaktā rathino rathibhiḥ saha,
9.22.41: yuddhānyāsan mahārāja ghorāṇi ca bahūni ca ॥41॥
9.22.45: rajasā tena sampr̥kto bhāskaro niṣprabhaḥ kr̥taḥ,
9.23.1: abhajyata balaṁ tatra tava putrasya pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥1॥
9.23.4: pareṣāṁ tava sainye vā nāsīt kaścit parāṅmukhaḥ ॥4॥
9.23.6: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā krodhena mahatā yutaḥ,
9.23.9: tato duryodhano rājā rathān saptaśatān raṇe,
9.23.16: tatra yuddhaṁ mahaccāsīt tava putrasya pāṇḍavaiḥ,
na ca tat tādr̥śaṁ dr̥ṣṭaṁ naiva cāpi pariśrutam ॥16॥
9.23.35: asau subalaputro no jaghanaṁ pīḍya daṁśitaḥ,
9.23.36: gaccha tvaṁ draupadeyaiśca śakuniṁ saubalaṁ jahi,
9.23.37: gacchantu kuñjarāḥ sarve vājinaśca saha tvayā,
9.23.42: te tatra sādinaḥ śūrāḥ saubalasya mahad balam,
9.23.43: prāvartata mahad yuddhaṁ rājan durmantrite tava ॥43॥
9.23.44: na hi sveṣāṁ pareṣāṁ vā viśeṣaḥ pratyadr̥śyata ॥44॥
9.23.49: āvikṣatāḥ sma dr̥śyante vamanto rudhiraṁ mukhaiḥ ॥49॥
9.23.51: aśvān rājan manuṣyāṁśca rajasā saṁvr̥te sati,
9.23.56: dūraṁ na śakyaṁ tatrāsīd gantumaśvena kenacit,
9.23.58: sa muhūrtaṁ tato yuddhvā saubalo’tha viśāmpate ॥58॥
9.23.61: na hi śakyaṁ rathairyoddhuṁ kuta evaṁ mahāgajaiḥ ॥61॥
9.23.63: tatastu draupadeyāśca te ca mattā mahādvipāḥ ॥63॥
9.23.65: ekākī prayayau tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
9.23.82: yodhāḥ paripatanti sma vamanto rudhiraṁ vraṇaiḥ ॥82॥
9.23.83: śiro gr̥hītvā keśeṣu kabandhaḥ sma pradr̥śyate,
udyamya ca śitaṁ khaḍgaṁ rudhireṇa pariplutam ॥83॥
9.23.85: mandībhūte tataḥ śabde pāṇḍavānāṁ mahad balam,
9.23.91: pitr̥̄n bhrātr̥̄n vayasyāṁśca putrānapi tathā pare ॥91॥
9.24.1: tasmin śabde mr̥dau jāte pāṇḍavairnihate bale,
9.24.2: sa yātvā vāhinīṁ tūrṇamabravīt tvarayan yudhi,
9.24.3: apr̥cchat kṣatriyāṁstatra kva nu rājā mahābalaḥ,
9.24.6: tatra gaccha drutaṁ rājaṁstato drakṣyasi kauravam,
9.24.10: jahi rājan rathānīkamaśvāḥ sarve jitā mayā,
nātyaktvā jīvitaṁ saṅkhye śakyo jetuṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥10॥
9.24.12: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya tāvakā jayagr̥ddhinaḥ,
9.24.18: kṣayamadya gatā yuddhe paśya daivaṁ yathāvidham ॥18॥
9.24.20: hate bhīṣme tu sandadhyācchivaṁ syādiha mādhava,
na ca tat kr̥tavān mūḍho dhārtarāṣṭraḥ subāliśaḥ ॥20॥
9.24.21: uktaṁ bhīṣmeṇa yad vākyaṁ hitaṁ tathyaṁ ca mādhava,
9.24.22: na jāne kāraṇaṁ kiṁ tu yena yuddhamavartata ॥22॥
9.24.23: patite śāntanoḥ putre ye’kārṣuḥ saṁyugaṁ punaḥ ॥23॥
9.24.24: anantaraṁ ca nihate droṇe brahmavidāṁ vare,
rādheye ca vikarṇe ca naivāśāmyata vaiśasam ॥24॥
9.24.26: śrutāyuṣi hate vīre jalasandhe ca paurave,
9.24.27: bhūriśravasi śalye ca śālve caiva janārdana,
9.24.29: bhagadatte hate śūre kāmboje ca sudāruṇe,
9.24.31: mohād vā yadi vā lobhānnaivāśāmyata vaiśasam ॥31॥
9.24.32: ko nu rājakule jātaḥ kauraveyo viśeṣataḥ,
9.24.33: amūḍhaḥ ko nu yuddhyeta jānan prājño hitāhitam ॥33॥
9.24.34: yanna tasya mano hyāsīt tvayoktasya hitaṁ vacaḥ,
praśame pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ so’nyasya śr̥ṇuyāt katham ॥34॥
9.24.35: yena śāntanavo vīro droṇo vidura eva ca,
pratyākhyātāḥ śamasyārthe kiṁ nu tasyādya bheṣajam ॥35॥
9.24.36: maurkhyād yena pitā vr̥ddhaḥ pratyākhyāto janārdana,
tathā mātā hitaṁ vākyaṁ bhāṣamāṇā hitaiṣiṇī ॥36॥
9.24.37: pratyākhyātā hyasatkr̥tya sa kasmai rocayed vacaḥ,
9.24.38: naiṣa dāsyati no rājyamiti me matiracyuta ॥38॥
9.24.39: na jīvan dāsyate bhāgaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrastu mānada ॥39॥
9.24.41: na ca yukto’nyathā jetumr̥te yuddhena mādhava,
ityabravīt sadā māṁ hi viduraḥ satyadarśanaḥ ॥41॥
9.24.43: yo hi śrutvā vacaḥ pathyaṁ jāmadagnyād yathātatham,
9.24.44: enaṁ prāpya durātmānaṁ kṣayaṁ kṣatraṁ gamiṣyati ॥44॥
9.24.45: tadidaṁ vacanaṁ teṣāṁ niruktaṁ vai janārdana,
kṣayaṁ yātā hi rājāno duryodhanakr̥te bhr̥śam ॥45॥
9.24.46: so’dya sarvān raṇe yodhān nihaniṣyāmi mādhava,
kṣatriyeṣu hateṣvāśu śūnye ca śibire kr̥te ॥46॥
9.24.48: evaṁ paśyāmi vārṣṇeya cintayan prajñayā svayā,
vidurasya ca vākyena ceṣṭayā ca durātmanaḥ ॥48॥
9.24.49: tasmād yāhi camūṁ vīra yāvaddhanmi śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.24.58: apatanta raṇe bāṇāḥ pataṅgā iva ghoṣiṇaḥ ॥58॥
9.24.59: na prājñāyanta samare diśo vā pradiśo’pi vā ॥59॥
9.24.61: pārthaṁ na prajahurghorā vadhyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥61॥
9.25.24: tava putro mahārāja prayayau yatra saubalaḥ ॥24॥
9.25.26: te vr̥tāḥ samare pañca gajānīkena bhārata,
9.25.32: āvignaṁ ca balaṁ sarvaṁ gadāhaste vr̥kodare ॥32॥
9.25.38: dr̥ṣṭvā ca pāṇḍavān sarvān kuñjaraiḥ parivāritān,
9.25.40: apr̥cchan kṣatriyāṁstatra kva nu duryodhano gataḥ ॥40॥
9.25.41: manvānā nihataṁ tatra tava putraṁ mahārathāḥ ॥41॥
9.25.42: āhuḥ keciddhate sūte prayāto yatra saubalaḥ ॥42॥
9.25.44: duryodhanena kiṁ kāryaṁ drakṣyadhvaṁ yadi jīvati,
yuddhyadhvaṁ sahitāḥ sarve kiṁ vo rājā kariṣyati ॥44॥
9.25.46: idaṁ sarvaṁ balaṁ hanmo yena sma parivāritāḥ,
ete sarve gajān hatvā upayānti sma pāṇḍavāḥ ॥46॥
9.25.48: kr̥paśca kr̥tavarmā ca prayayau yatra saubalaḥ,
9.25.49: āyayuḥ pāṇḍavā rājan vinighnantaḥ sma tāvakam ॥49॥
9.25.53: tasmin deśe vyavasthāya yatra śāradvataḥ sthitaḥ,
9.25.54: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ mahāraudraṁ tatra no’bhūd raṇo mahān,
jitāstena vayaṁ sarve vyapayāma raṇāt tataḥ ॥54॥
9.25.63: parityajya ca pāñcālyaṁ prayātā yatra saubalaḥ,
9.26.6: ityete sahitā bhūtvā tava putrāḥ samantataḥ ॥6॥
9.26.8: mumoca niśitān bāṇān putrāṇāṁ tava marmasu,
9.26.9: tataḥ kruddho raṇe bhīmaḥ śiro durmarṣaṇasya ha ॥9॥
9.26.12: sa papāta rathād rājan bhūmau tūrṇaṁ mamāra ca ॥12॥
9.26.13: śrutarvā tu tato bhīmaṁ kruddho vivyādha māriṣa,
9.26.14: tataḥ kruddho raṇe bhīmo jaitraṁ bhūribalaṁ ravim,
9.26.15: te hatā nyapatan bhūmau svandanebhyo mahārathāḥ,
9.26.17: sa hataḥ prāpatad bhūmau svarathād rathināṁ varaḥ,
9.26.18: duṣpradharṣaṁ tataścaiva sujātaṁ ca sutaṁ tava,
ekaikaṁ nyahanat saṅkhye dvābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ camūmukhe ॥18॥
9.26.19: tataḥ patantaṁ samare abhivīkṣya sutaṁ tava ॥19॥
9.26.20: sa papāta hato vāhāt paśyatāṁ sarvadhanvinām ॥20॥
9.26.21: dr̥ṣṭvā tu nihatān bhrātr̥̄n bahūnekena saṁyuge,
9.26.23: sa tu rājan dhanuśchittvā pāṇḍavasya mahāmr̥dhe,
9.26.24: avākirat tava sutaṁ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ॥24॥
9.26.26: samācchannā dharā sarvā khaṁ diśo vidiśastathā ॥26॥
9.26.29: tato bhīmo ruṣāviṣṭaḥ putrasya tava māriṣa,
9.26.35: te tu taṁ vai samāsādya parivavruḥ samantataḥ ॥35॥
9.26.38: vājināṁ ca śatānyaṣṭau pāṇḍavaḥ sma virājate ॥38॥
9.26.39: mene kr̥tārthamātmānaṁ saphalaṁ janma ca prabho ॥39॥
9.26.40: taṁ tathā yuddhyamānaṁ ca vinighnantaṁ ca tāvakān,
īkṣituṁ notsahante sma tava sainyā narādhipa ॥40॥
9.26.41: vidrāvya ca kurūn sarvāṁstāṁśca hatvā padānugān,
9.27.6: asau tiṣṭhati pāñcālyaḥ śriyā paramayā yutaḥ,
9.27.9: gajānīkaṁ hataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tvāṁ ca prāptamarindama,
9.27.11: hatvā tava balaṁ sarvaṁ saṅgrāme dhr̥tarāṣṭrajaḥ,
jitān pāṇḍusutān matvā rūpaṁ dhārayate mahat ॥11॥
9.27.12: nihataṁ svabalaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pīḍitaṁ cāpi pāṇḍavaiḥ,
9.27.14: hato bhīṣmo hato droṇaḥ karṇo vaikartano hataḥ ॥14॥
9.27.15: madrarājo hataḥ śalyo hataḥ kr̥ṣṇa jayadrathaḥ,
hayāḥ pañcaśatāḥ śiṣṭāḥ śakuneḥ saubalasya ca ॥15॥
9.27.16: rathānāṁ tu śate śiṣṭe dve eva tu janārdana,
dantināṁ ca śataṁ sāgraṁ trisāhasrāḥ padātayaḥ ॥16॥
9.27.18: mokṣo na nūnaṁ kālāt tu vidyate bhuvi kasyacit ॥18॥
9.27.19: tathā vinihate sainye paśya duryodhanaṁ sthitam,
9.27.20: na hi me mokṣyate kaścit pareṣāmiha cintaye,
ye tvadya samaraṁ kr̥ṣṇa na hāsyanti madotkaṭāḥ ॥20॥
9.27.21: tān vai sarvān haniṣyāmi yadyapi syurna mānuṣāḥ,
adya yuddhe susaṅkruddho dīrghaṁ rājñā prajāgaram ॥21॥
9.27.22: nikr̥tyā vai durācāro yāni ratnāni saubalaḥ ॥22॥
9.27.23: adya tā api rotsyanti sarvā nāgapure striyaḥ ॥23॥
9.27.24: samāptamadya vai karma sarvaṁ kr̥ṣṇa bhaviṣyati ॥24॥
9.27.25: adya duryodhano dīptāṁ śriyaṁ prāṇāṁśca mokṣyati,
nāpayāti bhayāt kr̥ṣṇa saṅgrāmād yadi cenmama ॥25॥
9.27.32: tato hi yatnataḥ kṣipraṁ tava putro janādhipa ॥32॥
9.27.36: tadanīkaṁ tadā pārtho vyadhamad bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥36॥
9.27.41: yathā siṁho vane rājan mr̥gaṁ paribubhukṣitaḥ,
taṁ nihatya tataḥ pārthaḥ suśarmāṇaṁ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥41॥
9.27.42: tataḥ prāyāt tvaran pārtho dīrghakālaṁ susaṁvr̥tam ॥42॥
9.27.44: pūrayitvā tato bāhān prāharat tasya dhanvinaḥ,
9.27.48: sapta cāṣṭau ca triṁśacca sāyakairanayat kṣayam,
9.27.49: bhīmastu samare kruddhaḥ putraṁ tava janādhipa ॥49॥
9.27.51: kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena sa hataḥ prāpatad bhuvi,
9.27.52: parivavrū raṇe bhīmaṁ kiranto vividhān śarān,
9.27.53: tataḥ kṣaṇena tad bhīmo nyahanad bharatarṣabha ॥53॥
9.27.56: vyākulaṁ tadabhūt sarvaṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ paraiḥ saha ॥56॥
9.27.57: ubhayoḥ senayo rājan saṁśocantaḥ sma bāndhavān ॥57॥
9.28.3: ulūkaśca raṇe bhīmaṁ vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
śakuniśca mahārāja bhīmaṁ viddhvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥3॥
9.28.4: te śūrāḥ samare rājan samāsādya parasparam ॥4॥
9.28.6: ācchādayad diśaḥ sarvā dhārā iva payomucaḥ ॥6॥
9.28.7: tataḥ kruddho raṇe bhīmaḥ sahadevaśca bhārata,
9.28.8: tābhyāṁ śaraśataiśchannaṁ tad balaṁ tava bhārata,
9.28.9: tatra tatra vr̥to mārgo vikarṣadbhirhatān bahūn ॥9॥
9.28.11: sañchannā pr̥thivī jajñe kusumaiḥ śabalā iva ॥11॥
9.28.22: iha kīrtiṁ samādhāya pretya lokān samaśnute ॥22॥
9.28.23: prāṇān jahāti yo dhīro yuddhe pr̥ṣṭhamadarśayan,
9.28.28: vivyādha nakulaṁ ṣaṣṭyā bhīmasenaṁ ca saptabhiḥ ॥28॥
9.28.29: sahadevaṁ ca saptatyā parīpsan pitaraṁ raṇe ॥29॥
9.28.30: taṁ bhīmasenaḥ samare vivyādha navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
9.28.33: sa jagāma rathād bhūmiṁ sahadevena pātitaḥ ॥33॥
9.28.34: putraṁ tu nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śakunistatra bhārata ॥34॥
9.28.39: asiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tathā cchinnaṁ pragr̥hya mahatīṁ gadām ॥39॥
9.28.40: prāhiṇot sahadevāya sā moghā nyapatad bhuvi,
9.28.42: sā papāta tridhā cchinnā bhūmau kanakabhūṣaṇā ॥42॥
9.28.43: śīryamāṇā yathā dīptā gaganād vai śatahradā,
śaktiṁ vinihatāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā saubalaṁ ca bhayārditam ॥43॥
9.28.45: tān vai vimanaso dr̥ṣṭvā mādrīputraḥ pratāpavān ॥45॥
9.28.48: adhijyaṁ balavat kr̥tvā vyākṣipan sumahad dhanuḥ ॥48॥
9.28.50: kṣatradharme sthiro bhūtvā yudhyasva puruṣo bhava ॥50॥
9.28.51: yat tadā hyaṣyase mūḍha glahannakṣaiḥ sabhātale,
9.28.56: chatraṁ dhvajaṁ dhanuścāsya cchittvā siṁha ivānadat ॥56॥
9.29.7: uvāca sahitān sarvān dhārtarāṣṭra idaṁ vacaḥ ॥7॥
9.29.8: pāñcālyaṁ cāpi sabalaṁ hatvā śīghraṁ nyavartata ॥8॥
9.29.9: tasya te śirasā gr̥hya vacanaṁ yuddhadurmadāḥ,
9.29.14: tato niḥśeṣamabhavat tat sainyaṁ tava bhārata ॥14॥
9.29.15: ekādaśa hatā yuddhe tāḥ prabho pāṇḍusr̥ñjayaiḥ ॥15॥
9.29.17: tato vīkṣya diśaḥ sarvā dr̥ṣṭvā śūnyāṁ ca medinīm,
9.29.20: nihate māmake sainye niḥśeṣe śibire kr̥te,
pāṇḍavānāṁ bale sūta kiṁ nu śeṣamabhūt tadā ॥20॥
9.29.21: etanme pr̥cchato brūhi kuśalo hyasi sañjaya,
9.29.22: balakṣayaṁ tathā dr̥ṣṭvā sa ekaḥ pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
rathānāṁ dve sahasre tu sapta nāgaśatāni ca ॥22॥
9.29.23: pañca cāśvasahasrāṇi pattīnāṁ ca śataṁ śatāḥ,
9.29.24: parigr̥hya hi yad yuddhe dhr̥ṣṭadyumno vyavasthitaḥ,
9.29.25: nāpaśyat samare kañcit sahāyaṁ rathināṁ varaḥ,
nardamānān parān dr̥ṣṭvā svabalasya ca saṅkṣayam ॥25॥
9.29.26: tathā dr̥ṣṭvā mahārāja ekaḥ sa pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
9.29.29: idaṁ nūnaṁ mahāprājño viduro dr̥ṣṭavān purā,
9.29.33: tān hatvā niśitairbāṇaiḥ sāmātyān saha bandhubhiḥ,
9.29.44d1: āhr̥tya ca karaṁ sarvaṁ svasya vai vaśamāgatam.
9.29.44d3: nābhavad yasya śastreṣu khedo rājñaḥ praśāsataḥ.
9.29.44d7: tiṣṭhantamekaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu mamābhūt kleśa uttamaḥ.
9.29.46: sa muhūrtamiva dhyātvā pratilabhya ca cetanām,
9.29.47: bhrātr̥̄ṁśca nihatān sarvān sainyaṁ ca vinipātitam ॥47॥
9.29.49: sa dīrghamiva niḥśvasya pratyavekṣya punaḥ punaḥ,
asau māṁ pāṇinā spr̥ṣṭvā putraste paryabhāṣata ॥49॥
9.29.52: pāṇḍavaiśca hr̥te rājye ko nu jīveta mādr̥śaḥ ॥52॥
9.29.53: ācakṣīthāḥ sarvamidaṁ māṁ ca muktaṁ mahāhavāt,
9.29.55: tasmin hradaṁ praviṣṭe tu trīn rathān śrāntavāhanān,
9.29.56: kr̥paṁ śāradvataṁ vīraṁ drauṇiṁ ca rathināṁ varam,
9.29.58: apr̥cchaṁścaiva māṁ sarve putraṁ tava janādhipam,
kaccid duryodhano rājā sa no jīvati sañjaya ॥58॥
9.29.60: aśvatthāmā tu tad rājan niśamya vacanaṁ mama ॥60॥
9.29.61: taṁ hradaṁ vipulaṁ prekṣya karuṇaṁ paryadevayat,
ahodhik sa na jānāti jīvato’smān narādhipaḥ ॥61॥
9.29.62: paryāptā hi vayaṁ tena saha yodhayituṁ parān,
te tu tatra ciraṁ kālaṁ vilapya ca mahārathāḥ ॥62॥
9.29.63: prādravan rathināṁ śreṣṭhā dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍusutān raṇe,
te tu māṁ rathamāropya kr̥pasya supariṣkr̥tam ॥63॥
9.29.64: tatra gulmāḥ paritrastāḥ sūrye cāstamite sati ॥64॥
9.29.65: sarve vicukruśuḥ śrutvā putrāṇāṁ tava saṅkṣayam,
tato vr̥ddhā mahārāja yoṣitāṁ rakṣiṇo narāḥ ॥65॥
9.29.67: tatastā yoṣito rājan krandantyo vai muhurmuhuḥ ॥67॥
9.29.69: lulucuśca tadā keśān krośantyastatra tatra ha,
9.29.74: dadr̥śustā mahārāja janā yātāḥ puraṁ prati ॥74॥
9.29.77: api caiṣāṁ bhayaṁ tīvraṁ pārthebhyo’bhūt sudāruṇam,
9.29.82: hariṇā iva vitrastā vīkṣamāṇā diśo daśa ॥82॥
9.29.84: prāptakālamahaṁ manye praveśaṁ taiḥ saha prabhum,
9.29.90: diṣṭyā kurukṣaye vr̥tte asmiṁstvaṁ putra jīvasi,
vinā rājñaḥ praveśād vai kimasi tvamihāgataḥ ॥90॥
9.29.91: etad vai kāraṇaṁ sarvaṁ vistareṇa nivedaya,
9.29.92: svakaṁ sa hayamutsr̥jya prāṅmukhaḥ prādravad bhayāt ॥92॥
9.29.94: tato rājñaḥ kalatrāṇi bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ cāsya sarvataḥ,
9.29.104: viveśa nagare rājan niḥśaśvāsa śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ॥104॥
9.29.105: yuyutsurapi tāṁ rātriṁ svagr̥he nyavasat tadā,
9.30.4: niśamya pāṇḍuputrāṇāṁ tadā vai jayināṁ svanam,
9.30.9: tataḥ kr̥paśca drauṇiśca kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ ॥9॥
9.30.10: te taṁ hradaṁ samāsādya yatra śete janādhipaḥ ॥10॥
9.30.12: jitvā vā pr̥thivīṁ bhuṅkṣva hato vā svargamāpnuhi,
teṣāmapi balaṁ sarvaṁ hataṁ duryodhana tvayā ॥12॥
9.30.13: na te vegaṁ viṣahituṁ śaktāstava viśāmpate ॥13॥
9.30.16: udīrṇaṁ ca balaṁ teṣāṁ tena yuddhaṁ na rocaye ॥16॥
9.30.17: na tvetadadbhutaṁ vīrā yad vo mahadidaṁ manaḥ,
asmāsu ca parā bhaktirna tu kālaḥ parākrame ॥17॥
9.30.18: pratiyotsyāmyahaṁ śatrūn śvo na me’styatra saṁśayaḥ ॥18॥
9.30.19: uttiṣṭha rājan bhadraṁ te vijeṣyāmo vayaṁ parān ॥19॥
9.30.20: iṣṭāpūrtena dānena satyena ca japena ca,
śape rājan yathā hyadya nihaniṣyāmi somakān ॥20॥
9.30.21: yadīmāṁ rajanīṁ vyuṣṭāṁ na hi hanmi parān raṇe ॥21॥
9.30.24: te tatra dhiṣṭhitāsteṣāṁ sarvaṁ tad vacanaṁ rahaḥ,
9.30.27: teṣāṁ śrutvā ca saṁvādaṁ rājñaśca salile sataḥ,
9.30.28: te pūrvaṁ pāṇḍuputreṇa pr̥ṣṭā hyāsan sutaṁ tava,
9.30.29: tataste pāṇḍuputrasya smr̥tvā tad bhāṣitaṁ tadā,
9.30.30: suvyaktamiha naḥ khyāto hrade duryodhano nr̥paḥ ॥30॥
9.30.31: tasmād gacchāmahe sarve yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
9.30.33: sa no dāsyati suprīto dhanāni bahulānyuta,
kiṁ no māṁsena śuṣkeṇa parikliṣṭena śoṣiṇā ॥33॥
9.30.34: evamuktvā tu te vyādhāḥ samprahr̥ṣṭā dhanārthinaḥ,
9.30.37: āgamya tu tataḥ sarve naṣṭaṁ duryodhanaṁ nr̥pam,
9.30.38: teṣāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā cārāṇāṁ bharatarṣabha,
9.30.40: ājagmuḥ śibiraṁ hr̥ṣṭā dr̥ṣṭvā duryodhanaṁ nr̥pam,
9.30.41: tasmai tat sarvamācakhyuryad vr̥ttaṁ yacca vaiśrutam ॥41॥
9.30.42: tato vr̥kodaro rājan dattvā teṣāṁ dhanaṁ bahu,
9.30.43: asau duryodhano rājan vijñāto mama lubdhakaiḥ,
9.30.44: tad vaco bhīmasenasya priyaṁ śrutvā viśāmpate,
9.30.45: taṁ ca śrutvā maheṣvāsaṁ praviṣṭaṁ salilahrade,
9.30.52: pañcālānāṁ ca ye śiṣṭā draupadeyāśca bhārata ॥52॥
9.30.55: māyayā salilaṁ stabhya yatrābhūt te sthitaḥ sutaḥ,
9.30.58: yudhiṣṭhiraśca rājendra taṁ hradaṁ saha sodaraiḥ,
9.30.62: tathetyuktvā hradaṁ taṁ vai māyayāstambhayat prabho ॥62॥
9.30.64: te gatvā dūramadhvānaṁ nyagrodhaṁ prekṣya māriṣa,
9.30.66: kathaṁ nu yuddhaṁ bhavitā kathaṁ rājā bhaviṣyati,
kathaṁ nu pāṇḍavā rājan pratipatsyanti kauravam ॥66॥
9.31.2: āsādya ca kuruśreṣṭha tadā dvaipāyanaṁ hradam,
9.31.4: viṣṭabhya salilaṁ śete nāsya mānuṣato bhayam,
9.31.5: nikr̥tyā nikr̥tiprajño na me jīvan vimokṣyate,
yadyasya samare sāhyaṁ kurute vajrabhr̥t svayam ॥5॥
9.31.6: tathāpyenaṁ hrataṁ yuddhe lokā drakṣyanti mādhava,
māyāvina imāṁ māyāṁ māyayā jahi bhārata ॥6॥
9.31.10: vr̥traśca nihato rājan kriyayaiva na saṁśayaḥ ॥10॥
9.31.15: kriyā balavatī rājan nānyat kiñcid yudhiṣṭhira,
9.31.17: jalasthaṁ taṁ mahārāja tava putraṁ mahābalam,
9.31.18: sarvaṁ kṣatraṁ ghātayitvā svakulaṁ ca viśāmpate ॥18॥
9.31.20: sa te darpo naraśreṣṭha sa ca mānaḥ kva te gataḥ,
yastvaṁ saṁstabhya salilaṁ bhīto rājan vyavasthitaḥ ॥20॥
9.31.21: sarve tvāṁ śūra ityevaṁ janā jalpanti saṁsadi,
vyarthaṁ tad bhavato manye śauryaṁ salilaśāyinaḥ ॥21॥
9.31.22: kauraveyo viśeṣeṇa kulaṁ janma ca saṁsmara ॥22॥
9.31.23: sa kathaṁ kaurave vaṁśe praśaṁsan janma cātmanaḥ,
9.31.25: kathaṁ pāramagatvā hi yuddhe tvaṁ vai jijīviṣuḥ,
imān nipatitān dr̥ṣṭvā putrān bhrātr̥̄n pitr̥̄ṁstathā ॥25॥
9.31.26: ghātayitvā kathaṁ tāta hrade tiṣṭhasi sāmpratam ॥26॥
9.31.27: śūramānī na śūrastvaṁ mr̥ṣā vadasi bhārata,
9.31.28: na hi śūrāḥ palāyante śatrūn dr̥ṣṭvā kathañcana,
brūhi vā tvaṁ yayā vr̥ttyā śūra tyajasi saṅgaram ॥28॥
9.31.31: yat tu karṇamupāśritya śakuniṁ cāpi saubalam,
amartya iva sammohāt tvamātmānaṁ na buddhavān ॥31॥
9.31.32: tat pāpaṁ sumahat kr̥tvā pratiyuddhyasva bhārata,
kathaṁ hi tvadvidho mohād rocayeta palāyanam ॥32॥
9.31.33: kva te tat pauruṣaṁ yātaṁ kva ca mānaḥ suyodhana,
kva ca vikrāntatā yātā kva ca visphūrjitaṁ mahat ॥33॥
9.31.34: kva te kr̥tāstratā yātā kiñca śeṣe jalāśaye,
9.31.36: eṣa te paramo dharmaḥ sr̥ṣṭo dhātrā mahātmanā,
taṁ kuruṣva yathātathyaṁ rājā bhava mahāratha ॥36॥
9.31.38: na ca prāṇabhayād bhīto vyapayāto’smi bhārata ॥38॥
9.31.42: āśvastā eva sarve sma ciraṁ tvāṁ mr̥gayāmahe,
9.31.43: hatvā vā samare pārthān sphītaṁ rājyamavāpnuhi,
9.31.44: ta ime nihatāḥ sarve bhrātaro me janeśvara ॥44॥
9.31.47: na tvidānīmahaṁ manye kāryaṁ yuddhena karhicit,
droṇe karṇe ca saṁśānte nihate ca pitāmahe ॥47॥
9.31.48: asahāyo hi ko rājā rājyamicchet praśāsitum ॥48॥
9.31.49: bhavadbhiśca hr̥te rājye ko nu jīveta mādr̥śaḥ ॥49॥
9.31.50: ratirhi nāsti me rājye hatapakṣasya bhārata ॥50॥
9.31.51: eṣā te pr̥thivī rājan bhuṅkṣvaināṁ vigatajvaraḥ ॥51॥
9.31.52: na hi me nirjanasyāsti jīvite’dya spr̥hā vibho ॥52॥
9.31.53: gaccha tvaṁ bhuṅkṣva rājendra pr̥thivīṁ nihateśvarām,
9.31.56: yadi vāpi samarthaḥ syāstvaṁ dānāya suyodhana,
9.31.57: adharmeṇa na gr̥hṇīyāṁ tvayā dattāṁ mahīmimām,
na hi dharmaḥ smr̥to rājan kṣatriyasya pratigrahaḥ ॥57॥
9.31.58: tvāṁ tu yuddhe vinirjitya bhoktāsmi vasudhāmimām ॥58॥
9.31.59: tvayeyaṁ pr̥thivī rājan kinna dattā tadaiva hi ॥59॥
9.31.61: kimidānīṁ dadāsi tvaṁ ko hi te cittavibhramaḥ,
9.31.62: ācchettuṁ vā balād rājan sa kathaṁ dātumicchasi ॥62॥
9.31.63: māṁ tu nirjitya saṅgrāme pālayemāṁ vasundharām,
9.31.64: tanmātramapi tanmahyaṁ na dadāti purā bhavān,
9.31.65: sūcyagraṁ nātyajaḥ pūrvaṁ sa kathaṁ tyajasi kṣitim,
9.31.66: ko hi mūḍho vyavasyeta śatrordātuṁ vasundharām,
9.31.67: asmān vā tvaṁ parājitya praśādhi pr̥thivīmimām ॥67॥
9.31.68: āvayorjīvato rājan mayi ca tvayi ca dhruvam ॥68॥
9.31.69: jīvitaṁ tava duṣprajña mayi samprati vartate ॥69॥
9.31.70: jīvayeyamahaṁ kāmaṁ na tu tvaṁ jīvituṁ kṣamaḥ,
9.31.71: tvayā vinikr̥tā rājan rājyasya haraṇena ca ॥71॥
9.31.72: etasmāt kāraṇāt pāpa jīvitaṁ te na vidyate ॥72॥
9.31.73: evaṁ tu vividhā vāco jayayuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
kīrtayanti sma te vīrāstatra tatra janādhipa ॥73॥
9.32.2: na hi santarjanā tena śrutapūrvā kathañcana,
9.32.4: iyaṁ ca pr̥thivī sarvā samlecchāṭavikā bhr̥śam,
prasādād dhriyate yasya pratyakṣaṁ tava sañjaya ॥4॥
9.32.6: sa śrutvā kaṭukā vāco jayayuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
9.32.8: śrutvā sa kaṭukā vāco viṣamastho narādhipaḥ,
dīrghamuṣṇaṁ ca niḥśvasya salilasthaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥8॥
9.32.9: salilāntargato rājā dhunvan hastau punaḥ punaḥ,
9.32.12: ekaikena tu māṁ yūyaṁ yodhayadhvaṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
9.32.14: na me tvatto bhayaṁ rājan na ca pārthād vr̥kodarāt,
9.32.15: yamābhyāṁ yuyudhānād vā ye cānye tava sainikāḥ,
ekaḥ sarvānahaṁ kruddho vārayiṣye yudhi sthitaḥ ॥15॥
9.32.16: dharmaṁ caiveha kīrtiṁ ca pālayan prabavīmyaham ॥16॥
9.32.18: adya vaḥ sarathān sāśvānaśastro viratho’pi san,
9.32.22: mitrāṇāṁ suhr̥dāṁ caiva bāndhavānāṁ tathaiva ca,
ānr̥ṇyamadya gacchāmi hatvā tvāṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha ॥22॥
9.32.24: diṣṭyā śūro’si kauravya diṣṭyā jānāsi saṅgaram ॥24॥
9.32.25: yastvameko hi naḥ sarvān saṅgare yoddhumicchasi,
eka ekena saṅgamya yat te sammatamāyudham ॥25॥
9.32.26: tat tvamādāya yudhyasva prekṣakāste vayaṁ sthitāḥ,
svayamiṣṭaṁ ca te kāmaṁ vīra bhūyo dadāmyaham ॥26॥
9.32.27: hatvaikaṁ bhavato rājyaṁ hato vā svargamāpnuhi,
9.32.29: padātirgadayā saṅkhye sa yudhyatu mayā saha,
9.32.32: pañcālān sr̥ñjayāṁścaiva ce cānye tava sainikāḥ,
na hi me sambhramo jātu śakrādapi yudhiṣṭhira ॥32॥
9.32.33: eka ekena saṅgamya saṁyuge gadayā balī ॥33॥
9.32.34: adya te jīvitaṁ nāsti yadīndro’pi tavāśrayaḥ ॥34॥
9.32.38: sa bhittvā stambhitaṁ toyaṁ skandhe kr̥tvā’’yasīṁ gadām ॥38॥
9.32.40: gadāhastaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā saśr̥ṅgamiva parvatam ॥40॥
9.32.41: sagado bhārato bhāti pratapan bhāskaro yathā ॥41॥
9.32.43: vajrahastaṁ yathā śakraṁ śūlahastaṁ yathā haram,
9.32.45: avahāsaṁ tu taṁ matvā putro duryodhanastava,
9.32.46: pratyuvāca tatastān vai pāṇḍavān saha keśavān ॥46॥
9.32.49: śarīraṁ sma tadā bhāti sravanniva mahīdharaḥ ॥49॥
9.32.51: ājuhāva tataḥ pārthān gadayā yudhi vīryavān ॥51॥
9.32.52: na hyeko bahubhirnyāyyo vīro yodhayituṁ yudhi ॥52॥
9.32.54: yuktaṁ tvayuktamityetad vetsi tvaṁ caiva sarvadā ॥54॥
9.32.55: mā bhūdiyaṁ tava prajñā kathamevaṁ suyodhana,
9.32.56: anyathā tu kathaṁ hanyurabhimanyuṁ tathā gatam ॥56॥
9.32.58: yadyekastu na hantavyo bahubhirdharma eva tu,
9.32.60: āmuñca kavacaṁ vīra mūrdhajān yamayasva ca,
9.32.61: imamekaṁ ca te kāmaṁ vīra bhūyo dadāmyaham,
9.32.62: taṁ hatvā vai bhavān rājā hato vā svargamāpnuhi,
r̥te ca jīvitād vīra yuddhe kiṁ karma te priyam ॥62॥
9.32.63: tatastava suto rājan varma jagrāha kāñcanam,
9.32.66: sahadevena vā yotsye bhīmena nakulena vā ॥66॥
9.32.67: yotsye’haṁ saṅgaraṁ prāpya vijeṣye ca raṇājire ॥67॥
9.32.69: gadāyuddhe na me kaścit sadr̥śo’stīti cintaye,
9.32.70: na me samarthāḥ sarve vai yoddhuṁ nyāyena kecana,
athavā saphalaṁ hyetat kariṣye bhavatāṁ puraḥ ॥70॥
9.32.71: asmin muhurte satyaṁ vā mithyā vai tad bhaviṣyati,
gr̥hṇātu ca gadāṁ yo vai yotsyate’dya mayā saha ॥71॥
9.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiraduryodhanasaṁvāde dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
9.33.2: yadi nāma hyayaṁ yuddhe varayet tvāṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
9.33.4: etena hi kr̥tā yogyā varṣāṇīha trayodaśa ॥4॥
9.33.7: r̥te vr̥kodarāt pārthāt sa ca nātikr̥taśramaḥ,
9.33.8: balī bhīmaḥ samarthaśca kr̥tī rājā suyodhanaḥ ॥8॥
9.33.9: balavān vā kr̥tī veti kr̥tī rājan viśiṣyate,
so’yaṁ rājaṁstvayā śatruḥ same pathi niveśitaḥ ॥9॥
9.33.10: ko nu sarvān vinirjitya śatrūnekena vairiṇā ॥10॥
9.33.12: na hi paśyāmi taṁ loke yo’dya duryodhanaṁ raṇe,
gadāhastaṁ vijetuṁ vai śaktaḥ syādamaro’pi hi ॥12॥
9.33.13: na tvaṁ bhīmo na nakulaḥ sahadevo’tha phālgunaḥ,
jetuṁ nyāyena śakto vai kr̥tī rājā suyodhanaḥ ॥13॥
9.33.14: sa kathaṁ vadase śatruṁ yudhyasva gadayeti hi,
ekaṁ ca no nihatyājau bhava rājeti bhārata ॥14॥
9.33.15: vr̥kodaraṁ samāsādya saṁśayo vai jaye hi naḥ,
9.33.16: ekaṁ vāsmān nihatya tvaṁ bhava rājeti vai punaḥ,
nūnaṁ na rājyabhāgeṣā pāṇḍoḥ kuntyāśca santatiḥ ॥16॥
9.33.18: ahaṁ suyodhanaṁ saṅkhye haniṣyāmi na saṁśayaḥ ॥18॥
9.33.19: vijayo vai dhruvaḥ kr̥ṣṇa dharmarājasya dr̥śyate,
9.33.20: na tathā dhārtarāṣṭrasya mā kārṣīrmādhava vyathām,
9.33.21: bhavantaḥ prekṣakāḥ sarve mama santu janārdana,
9.33.24: nihatāriḥ svakāṁ dīptāṁ śriyaṁ prāpto na saṁśayaḥ,
9.33.27: tvāṁ ca prāpya raṇe pāpo dhārtarāṣṭro vinaṅkṣyati ॥27॥
9.33.28: yatnena tu sadā pārtha yoddhavyo dhr̥tarāṣṭrajaḥ ॥28॥
9.33.32: na hi śakto raṇe jetuṁ māmeṣa puruṣādhamaḥ ॥32॥
9.33.33: adya krodhaṁ vimokṣyāmi nihitaṁ hr̥daye bhr̥śam,
9.33.34: nihatya gadayā pāpamadya rājan sukhī bhava ॥34॥
9.33.35: prāṇām śriyaṁ ca rājyaṁ ca mokṣyate’dya suyodhanaḥ ॥35॥
9.33.36: rājā ca dhr̥tarāṣṭro’dya śrutvā putraṁ mayā hatam,
9.33.41: na sambhramo na ca bhayaṁ na ca glānirna ca vyathā,
9.33.43: rājñāpi dhr̥tarāṣṭreṇa tvayā cāsmāsu yat kr̥tam,
smara tad duṣkr̥taṁ karma yad bhūtaṁ vāraṇāvate ॥43॥
9.33.45: anāgaḥsu ca pārtheṣu tasya paśya mahat phalam ॥45॥
9.33.47: hato droṇaśca karṇaśca hataḥ śalyaḥ pratāpavān,
9.33.49: ete cānye ca nihatā bahavaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ,
9.33.51: adya te’haṁ raṇe darpaṁ sarvaṁ nāśayitā nr̥pa,
rājyāśāṁ vipulāṁ rājan pāṇḍaveṣu ca duṣkr̥tam ॥51॥
9.33.52: kiṁ katthitena bahunā yuddhyasvādya mayā saha,
9.33.53: kiṁ na paśyasi māṁ pāpa gadāyuddhe vyavasthitam,
9.33.54: gadinaṁ ko’dya māṁ pāpa hantumutsahate ripuḥ,
9.33.55: darśayasva balaṁ yuddhe yāvat tat te’dya vidyate ॥55॥
9.33.56: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā pāṇḍavāḥ sahasr̥ñjayāḥ,
9.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi bhīmasenaduryodhanasaṁvāde trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
9.34.4: śiṣyayoḥ kauśalaṁ yuddhe paśya rāmeti pārthiva ॥4॥
9.34.5: abravīcca tadā rāmo dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥ṣṇaṁ sapāṇḍavam,
9.34.6: catvāriṁśadahānyadya dve ca me niḥsr̥tasya vai,
9.34.10: mādrīputrau tathā śūrau draupadyāḥ pañca cātmajāḥ ॥10॥
9.34.12: svāgatena ca te tatra pratipūjya samantataḥ ॥12॥
9.34.13: paśya yuddhaṁ mahābāho iti te rāmamabruvan,
9.34.16: janārdanaṁ sātyakiṁ ca premṇā sa pariṣasvaje ॥16॥
9.34.17: tau ca taṁ vidhivad rājan pūjayāmāsaturgurum ॥17॥
9.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevāgamane catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
9.35.1: āmantrya keśavaṁ yāto vr̥ṣṇibhiḥ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ॥1॥
9.35.2: sāhāyyaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrasya na ca kartāsmi keśava,
9.35.4: ākhyāhi me vistaraśaḥ kathaṁ rāma upasthitaḥ,
kathaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭavān yuddhaṁ kuśalo hyasi sattama ॥4॥
9.35.6: sa gatvā hāstinapuraṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ sametya ca ॥6॥
9.35.7: uktavān vacanaṁ tathyaṁ hitaṁ caiva viśeṣataḥ,
na ca tat kr̥tavān rājā yathā khyātaṁ hi tat purā ॥7॥
9.35.10: na kurvanti vaco mahyaṁ kuravaḥ kālanoditāḥ,
9.35.12: kriyatāmiti tat kr̥ṣṇo nāsya cakre vacastadā ॥12॥
9.35.20: evaṁ sandiśya tu preṣyān baladevo mahābalaḥ ॥20॥
9.35.21: tīrthayātrāṁ yayau rājan kurūṇāṁ vaiśase tadā,
9.35.24: deśe deśe tu deyāni dānāni vividhāni ca,
9.35.25: tāni yānīha deśeṣu pratīkṣanti sma bhārata,
9.35.26: yo yo yatra dvijo bhojyaṁ bhoktuṁ kāmayate tadā,
9.35.27: tatra tatra sthitā rājan rauhiṇeyasya śāsanāt,
9.35.29: yatra yaḥ svapate vipro yo vā jāgarti bhārata,
tatra tatra tu tasyaiva sarvaṁ klr̥ptamadr̥śyata ॥29॥
9.35.30: yathāsukhaṁ janaḥ sarvo yāti tiṣṭhati vai tadā,
9.35.32: sa panthāḥ prababhau rājan sarvasyaiva sukhāvahaḥ,
9.35.38: phalaṁ ca dvipadāṁ śreṣṭha karmanirvr̥ttimeva ca ॥38॥
9.35.39: brahman brahmavidāṁ śreṣṭha paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥39॥
9.35.40: tīrthānāṁ ca phalaṁ rājan guṇotpattiṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
mayocyamānaṁ vai puṇyaṁ śr̥ṇu rājendra kr̥tsnaśaḥ ॥40॥
9.35.43: kathaṁ tu bhagavan somo yakṣmaṇā samagr̥hyata,
9.35.45: sa saptaviṁśatiṁ kanyā dakṣaḥ somāya vai dadau ॥45॥
9.35.46: patnyo vai tasya rājendra somasya śubhakarmaṇaḥ ॥46॥
9.35.48: tatastasyāṁ sa bhagavān prītiṁ cakre niśākaraḥ,
sāsya hr̥dyā babhūvātha tasmāt tāṁ bubhuje sadā ॥48॥
9.35.49: purā hi somo rājendra rohiṇyāmavasat param,
9.35.50: somo vasati nāsmāsu rohiṇīṁ bhajate sadā ॥50॥
9.35.52: śrutvā tāsāṁ tu vacanaṁ dakṣaḥ somamathābravīt,
samaṁ vartasva bhāryāsu mā tvādharmo mahān spr̥śet ॥52॥
9.35.53: samaṁ vatsyati sarvāsu candramā mama śāsanāt ॥53॥
9.35.56: tava śuśrūṣaṇe yuktā vatsyāmo hi tavāntike,
somo vasati nāsmāsu nākarod vacanaṁ tava ॥56॥
9.35.57: tāsāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā dakṣaḥ somamathābravīt,
samaṁ vartasva bhāryāsu mā tvāṁ śapsye virocana ॥57॥
9.35.58: anādr̥tya tu tad vākyaṁ dakṣasya bhagavān śaśī,
9.35.59: gatvā ca pitaraṁ prāhuḥ praṇamya śirasā tadā,
somo vasati nāsmāsu tasmānnaḥ śaraṇaṁ bhava ॥59॥
9.35.61: tasmānnastrāhi sarvā vai yathā naḥ soma āviśet,
9.35.63: yatnaṁ cāpyakarod rājan mokṣārthaṁ tasya yakṣmaṇaḥ,
9.35.64: na cāmucyata śāpād vai kṣayaṁ caivābhyagacchata,
kṣīyamāṇe tataḥ some oṣadhyo na prajajñire ॥64॥
9.35.67: kāraṇaṁ brūhi naḥ sarvaṁ yenedaṁ te mahad bhayam ॥67॥
9.35.68: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tvatto vidhāsyāmastato vayam,
9.35.69: śāpasya lakṣaṇaṁ caiva yakṣmāṇaṁ ca tathā’’tmanaḥ,
9.35.70: asau hi candramāḥ kṣīṇaḥ kiñciccheṣo hi lakṣyate ॥70॥
9.35.74: samaṁ vartatu sarvāsu śaśī bhāryāsu nityaśaḥ ॥74॥
9.35.75: punarvardhiṣyate devāstad vai satyaṁ vaco mama ॥75॥
9.35.76: māsārdhaṁ ca kṣayaṁ somo nityameva gamiṣyati,
māsārdhaṁ tu sadā vr̥ddhiṁ satyametad vaco mama ॥76॥
9.35.78: prabhāsaṁ prathamaṁ tīrthaṁ sarasvatyā jagāma ha ॥78॥
9.35.80: devāstu sarve rājendra prabhāsaṁ prāpya puṣkalam,
9.35.81: somaṁ ca bhagavān prīto bhūyo vacanamabravīt ॥81॥
9.35.82: māvamaṁsthāḥ striyaḥ putra mā ca viprān kadācana,
gaccha yuktaḥ sadā bhūtvā kuru vai śāsanaṁ mama ॥82॥
9.35.84: evaṁ te sarvamākhyātaṁ yathā śapto niśākaraḥ,
prabhāsaṁ ca yathā tīrthaṁ tīrthānāṁ pravaraṁ mahat ॥84॥
9.35.85: snātvā hyāpyāyate śrīmān prabhāse tīrtha uttame ॥85॥
9.35.86: prabhāṁ hi paramāṁ lebhe tasminnunmajjya candramāḥ ॥86॥
9.35.88: tatra dattvā ca dānāni viśiṣṭāni halāyudhaḥ,
9.35.89: ādyaṁ svastyayanaṁ caiva yatrāvāpya mahat phalam ॥89॥
9.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ prabhāsotpattikathane pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
9.36.2: tatra dattvā bahu dravyaṁ pūjayitvā tathā dvijān,
9.36.3: tatra dharmaparo bhūtvā tritaḥ sa sumahātapāḥ,
kūpe ca vasatā tena somaḥ pīto mahātmanā ॥3॥
9.36.5: udapānaṁ kathaṁ brahman kathaṁ ca sumahātapāḥ,
patitaḥ kiṁ ca santyakto bhrātr̥bhyāṁ dvijasattama ॥5॥
9.36.6: kūpe kathaṁ ca hitvainaṁ bhrātarau jagmaturgr̥hān,
kathaṁ ca yājayāmāsa papau somaṁ ca vai katham ॥6॥
9.36.7: etadācakṣva me brahman śrotavyaṁ yadi manyase,
9.36.9: teṣāṁ tu tapasā prīto niyamena damena ca ॥9॥
9.36.10: abhavad gautamo nityaṁ pitā dharmarataḥ sadā,
sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena teṣāṁ prītimavāpya ca ॥10॥
9.36.11: rājānastasya ye hyāsan yājyā rājan mahātmanaḥ ॥11॥
9.36.12: teṣāṁ tu karmaṇā rājaṁstathā cādhyayanena ca ॥12॥
9.36.13: tritaḥ sa śreṣṭhatāṁ prāpa yathaivāsya pitā tathā,
9.36.16: somaṁ pāsyāmahe hr̥ṣṭāḥ prāpya yajñaṁ mahāphalam ॥16॥
9.36.17: cakruścaivaṁ tathā rājan bhrātarastraya eva ca,
tathā te tu parikramya yājyān sarvān paśūn prati ॥17॥
9.36.18: yājayitvā tato yājyām̐llabdhvā tu subahūn paśūn,
9.36.21: kathaṁ ca syurimā gāva āvābhyāṁ hi vinā tritam,
9.36.23: tadāvāṁ sahitau bhūtvā gāḥ prakālya vrajāvahe ॥23॥
9.36.24: trito’pi gacchatāṁ kāmamāvābhyāṁ vai vinā kr̥taḥ,
9.36.25: atha trito vr̥kaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pathi tiṣṭhantamagrataḥ ॥25॥
9.36.26: tadbhayādapasarpan vai tasmin kūpe papāta ha,
9.36.31: somaḥ kathaṁ tu pātavya ihasthena mayā bhavet ॥31॥
9.36.33: pāṁsugraste tataḥ kūpe vicintya salilaṁ muniḥ,
9.36.34: r̥co yajūṁṣi sāmāni manasā cintayan muniḥ ॥34॥
9.36.35: ājyaṁ ca salilaṁ cakre bhāgāṁśca tridivaukasām ॥35॥
9.36.36: sa cāviśad divaṁ rājan punaḥ śabdastritasya vai ॥36॥
9.36.37: samavāpya ca taṁ yajñaṁ yathoktaṁ brahmavādibhiḥ,
9.36.38: āvignaṁ tridivaṁ sarvaṁ kāraṇaṁ ca na buddhyate,
9.36.40: sa hi kruddhaḥ sr̥jedanyān devānapi mahātapāḥ,
9.36.41: te tatra gatvā vibudhāstaṁ kūpaṁ yatra sa tritaḥ ॥41॥
9.36.42: dr̥ṣṭvā cainaṁ mahātmānaṁ śriyā paramayā yutam ॥42॥
9.36.45: tato yathāvidhi prāptān bhāgān prāpya divaukasaḥ ॥45॥
9.36.46: sa tu vavre varaṁ devāṁstrātumarhatha māmitaḥ ॥46॥
9.36.48: tatheti coktvā vibudhā jagmū rājan yathāgatāḥ ॥48॥
9.36.49: kruddhastu sa samāsādya tāvr̥ṣī bhrātarau tadā ॥49॥
9.36.50: uvāca paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ śaśāpa ca mahātapāḥ,
9.36.54: dattvā ca vividhān dāyān pūjayitvā ca vai dvijān,
udapānaṁ ca taṁ vīkṣya praśasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥54॥
9.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ tritākhyāne ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
9.37.1: śūdrābhīrān prati dveṣād yatra naṣṭā sarasvatī ॥1॥
9.37.2: tasmāt tu r̥ṣayo nityaṁ prāhurvinaśaneti ca,
9.37.4: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā māsi māsi janeśvara ॥4॥
9.37.7: puṇyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sadā divyaiḥ kīryamāṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
9.37.8: tatra snātvā ca dattvā ca vasu viprāya mādhavaḥ ॥8॥
9.37.9: śrutvā gītaṁ ca tad divyaṁ vāditrāṇāṁ ca niḥsvanam,
9.37.11: tatra dattvā haladharo viprebhyo vividhaṁ vasu ॥11॥
9.37.12: bhojayitvā dvijān kāmaiḥ santarpya ca mahādhanaiḥ ॥12॥
9.37.16: sarasvatyāḥ śubhe tīrthe viditā vai mahātmanā,
tasya nāmnā ca tat tīrthaṁ gargasrota iti smr̥tam ॥16॥
9.37.22: te sarve hyaśanaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ tasya vanaspateḥ ॥22॥
9.37.23: vrataiśca niyamaiścaiva kāle kāle sma bhuñjate,
9.37.24: evaṁ khyāto naravyāghra loke’smin sa vanaspatiḥ ॥24॥
9.37.27: tatra gatvā munīn dr̥ṣṭvā nānāveṣadharān balaḥ ॥27॥
9.37.28: āplutya salile cāpi pūjayāmāsa vai dvijān,
9.37.29: tataḥ prāyād balo rājan dakṣiṇena sarasvatīm,
9.37.31: r̥ṣīṇāṁ hi sahasrāṇi tatra nityaṁ caturdaśa ॥31॥
9.37.33: pannagebhyo bhayaṁ tatra vidyate na sma paurava,
9.37.34: prāyāt prācīṁ diśaṁ tatra tatra tīrthānyanekaśaḥ,
9.37.35: āplutya tatra tīrtheṣu yathoktaṁ tatra carṣibhiḥ,
9.37.38: nivr̥ttāṁ tāṁ saricchreṣṭhāṁ tatra dr̥ṣṭvā tu lāṅgalī,
9.37.44: tīrthāni nagarāyante kūle vai dakṣiṇe tadā ॥44॥
9.37.46: juhvatāṁ tatra teṣāṁ tu munīnāṁ bhāvitātmanām,
9.37.54: tataḥ kuñjān bahūn kr̥tvā saṁnivr̥ttā sarasvatī,
9.37.57: evaṁ sa kuñjo rājan vai naimiṣīya iti smr̥taḥ,
9.37.58: tatra kuñjān bahūn dr̥ṣṭvā nivr̥ttāṁ ca sarasvatīm,
9.37.59: dattvā dāyān dvijātibhyo bhāṇḍāni vividhāni ca ॥59॥
9.37.60: bhakṣyaṁ bhojyaṁ ca vividhaṁ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāya ca,
tataḥ prāyād balo rājan pūjyamāno dvijātibhiḥ ॥60॥
9.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
9.38.2: kasya vaṁśe samutpannaḥ kiṁ cādhītaṁ dvijottama,
9.38.4: suprabhā kāñcanākṣī ca viśālā ca manoramā,
9.38.6: deveṣu caiva vyagreṣu tasmin yajñavidhau tadā ॥6॥
9.38.13: suprabhā nāma rājendra nāmnā tatra sarasvatī ॥13॥
9.38.14: pitāmahaṁ mānayantīṁ kratuṁ te bahu menire ॥14॥
9.38.16: tatra citrāḥ kathā hyāsan vedaṁ prati janeśvara ॥16॥
9.38.18: sā tu dhyātā mahārāja r̥ṣibhaḥ satrayājibhiḥ,
9.38.20: āgatā saritāṁ śreṣṭhā tatra bhārata pūjitā,
9.38.23: samete sarvataḥ sphīte munīnāṁ maṇḍale tadā,
9.38.25: manorameti vikhyātā sā hi tairmanasā kr̥tā ॥25॥
9.38.30: samāhūtā yayau tatra puṇye haimavate girau,
9.38.32: saptasārasvataṁ caiva tīrthaṁ puṇyaṁ tathā smr̥tam,
9.38.35: tad retaḥ sa tu jagrāha kalaśe vai mahātapāḥ,
saptadhā pravibhāgaṁ tu kalaśasthaṁ jagāma ha ॥35॥
9.38.36: tatrarṣayaḥ sapta jātā jajñire marutāṁ gaṇāḥ,
9.38.39: purā maṅkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ kuśāgreṇeti naḥ śrutam,
9.38.40: sa vai śākarasaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā harṣāviṣṭaḥ pranr̥ttavān,
tatastasmin pranr̥tte vai sthāvaraṁ jaṅgamaṁ ca yat ॥40॥
9.38.42: nāyaṁ nr̥tyed yathā deva tathā tvaṁ kartumarhasi ॥42॥
9.38.43: tato devo muniṁ dr̥ṣṭvā harṣāviṣṭamatīva ha,
9.38.44: bho bho brāhmaṇa dharmajña kimarthaṁ nr̥tyate bhavān,
9.38.45: kiṁ na paśyasi me brahman karācchākarasaṁ srutam ॥45॥
9.38.46: yaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sampranr̥tto vai harṣeṇa mahatā vibho,
taṁ prahasyābravīd devo muniṁ rāgeṇa mohitam ॥46॥
9.38.47: ahaṁ na vismayaṁ vipra gacchāmīti prapaśya mām,
9.38.48: tato bhasma kṣatād rājan nirgataṁ himasaṁnibham ॥48॥
9.38.49: tad dr̥ṣṭvā vrīḍito rājan sa muniḥ pādayorgataḥ,
9.38.50: nānyaṁ devādahaṁ manye rudrāt parataraṁ mahat,
9.38.52: devairapi na śakyastvaṁ parijñātuṁ kuto mayā,
tvayi sarve sma dr̥śyante bhāvā ye jagati sthitāḥ ॥52॥
9.38.53: sarvastvamasi devānāṁ kartā kārayitā ca ha ॥53॥
9.38.54: evaṁ stutvā mahādevaṁ sa r̥ṣiḥ praṇato’bhavat ॥54॥
9.38.54d1: tvayi brahmā ca śakraśca lokān sandhārya tiṣṭhataḥ.
9.38.54d2: tvanmūlaṁ ca jagat sarvaṁ tvadantaṁ hi maheśvara,
tvayā hi vitatā lokāḥ sapteme sarvasambhava.
9.38.54d3: tvanmayaṁ hi jagat sarvaṁ bhūtaṁ sthāvarajaṅgamam.
9.38.54d6: prapadye śaraṇaṁ śambhuṁ sarvadā sarvataḥ sthitam,
9.38.55: tataḥ prasādayāmi tvāṁ tapo me na kṣarediti ॥55॥
9.38.57: āśrame ceha vatsyāmi tvayā sārdhamahaṁ sadā,
9.38.58: na tasya durlabhaṁ kiñcid bhaviteha paratra vā,
sārasvataṁ ca te lokaṁ gamiṣyanti na saṁśayaḥ ॥58॥
9.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne’ṣṭātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
9.39.1: tathā maṅkaṇake prītiṁ śubhāṁ cakre halāyudhaḥ ॥1॥
9.39.2: dattvā dānaṁ dvijātibhyo rajanīṁ tāmupoṣya ca,
9.39.3: anujñāpya munīn sarvān spr̥ṣṭvā toyaṁ ca bhārata,
9.39.8: vidhivad vai dadau vittaṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ mahātmanām,
9.39.9: muktaḥ kathaṁ cāsya śiro lagnaṁ kena ca hetunā,
9.39.12: sa tena lagnena tadā dvijātirna śaśāka ha ॥12॥
9.39.14: jagāma sarvatīrthāni pr̥thivyāṁ ceti naḥ śrutam,
sa gatvā saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāṁśca mahātapāḥ ॥14॥
9.39.16: sa tu śuśrāva viprendra munīnāṁ vacanaṁ mahat,
9.39.17: sa tu gatvā tatastatra tīrthamauśanasaṁ dvijaḥ ॥17॥
9.39.20: tataḥ sa viśirā rājan pūtātmā vītakalmaṣaḥ,
9.39.22: te śrutvā vacanaṁ tasya tatastīrthasya mānada,
9.39.23: pītvā payaḥ suvipulaṁ siddhimāyāt tadā muniḥ ॥23॥
9.39.24: tatra dattvā bahūn dāyān viprān sampūjya mādhavaḥ,
9.39.31: sa taiḥ putraistadā dhīmānānīto vai sarasvatīm,
9.39.35: dattvā caiva bahūn dāyān viprāṇāṁ vipravatsalaḥ,
9.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāna ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
9.40.2: tanmamācakṣva bhagavan paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥2॥
9.40.4: tasya rājan gurukule vasato nityameva ca,
samāptiṁ nāgamad vidyā nāpi vedā viśāmpate ॥4॥
9.40.5: tato vai tapasā tena prāpya vedānanuttamān ॥5॥
9.40.6: tatra tīrthe varān prādāt trīneva sumahātapāḥ ॥6॥
9.40.8: api cālpena kālena phalaṁ prāpsyati puṣkalam ॥8॥
9.40.14: na gantavyaṁ mahāprājña trāhi cāsmān mahābhayāt ॥14॥
9.40.15: viśvasya jagato goptā bhaviṣyati suto mama ॥15॥
9.40.16: ityuktvā tu tato gādhirviśvāmitraṁ niveśya ca,
9.40.17: na sa śaknoti pr̥thivīṁ yatnavānapi rakṣitum,
tataḥ śuśrāva rājā sa rākṣasebhyo mahābhayam ॥17॥
9.40.21: sr̥jasva śabarān ghorāniti svāṁ gāmuvāca ha,
9.40.25: tathā sthaṇḍilaśāyī ca ye cānye niyamāḥ pr̥thak,
9.40.26: tataḥ pareṇa yatnena taptvā bahuvidhaṁ tapaḥ ॥26॥
9.40.27: tapasā tu tathā yuktaṁ viśvāmitraṁ pitāmahaḥ ॥27॥
9.40.28: sa tu vavre varaṁ rājan syāmahaṁ brāhmaṇastviti ॥28॥
9.40.31: atha vastrāṇyalaṅkāraṁ bhakṣyaṁ peyaṁ ca śobhanam ॥31॥
9.40.32: yatra tepe tapastīvraṁ dālbhyo baka iti śrutiḥ ॥32॥
9.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
9.41.4d1: tatra te lebhire rājan pañcālebhyo maharṣayaḥ
9.41.8: ayācata paśūn dālbhyaḥ sa cainaṁ ruṣito’bravīt,
9.41.9: etān paśūn naya kṣipraṁ brahmabandho yadīcchasi,
9.41.10: aho bata nr̥śaṁsaṁ vai vākyamukto’smi saṁsadi,
9.41.11: sa tūtkr̥tya mr̥tānāṁ vai māṁsāni munisattamaḥ ॥11॥
9.41.13: bako dālbhyo mahārāja niyamaṁ paramaṁ sthitaḥ,
9.41.15: tataḥ prakṣīyamāṇaṁ tad rājyaṁ tasya mahīpateḥ,
9.41.16: dr̥ṣṭvā tathāvakīrṇaṁ tu rāṣṭraṁ sa manujādhipaḥ ॥16॥
9.41.18: na ca śreyo’dhyagacchattu kṣīyate rāṣṭrameva ca,
yadā sa pārthivaḥ khinnaste ca viprāstadānagha ॥18॥
9.41.19: yadā cāpi na śaknoti rāṣṭraṁ mokṣayituṁ nr̥pa,
9.41.21: tena te hūyamānasya rāṣṭrasyāsya kṣayo mahān,
tasyaitat tapasaḥ karma yena te’dya layo mahān ॥21॥
9.41.22: sarasvatīṁ tato gatvā sa rājā bakamabravīt ॥22॥
9.41.24: tvaṁ gatistvaṁ ca me nāthaḥ prasādaṁ kartumarhasi ॥24॥
