9.41.25: dr̥ṣṭvā tasya kr̥pā jajñe rāṣṭraṁ tasya vyamocayat ॥25॥
9.41.26: r̥ṣiḥ prasannastasyābhūt saṁrambhaṁ ca vihāya saḥ,
9.41.27: mokṣayitvā tato rāṣṭraṁ pratigr̥hya paśūn bahūn,
9.41.32: ratnāni ca mahārhāṇi dhanaṁ dhānyaṁ ca puṣkalam,
9.41.35: audāryaṁ paramaṁ kr̥tvā bhaktiṁ cātmani śāśvatīm ॥35॥
9.41.36: dadau kāmān brāhmaṇebhyo yān yān yo manasecchati,
yo yatra sthita eveha āhūto yajñasaṁstare ॥36॥
9.41.37: ṣaḍrasaṁ bhojanaṁ caiva dānaṁ nānāvidhaṁ tathā ॥37॥
9.41.38: rājānaṁ tuṣṭuvuḥ prītā dattvā caivāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ ॥38॥
9.41.39: tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ prītā yajñasya sampadā,
9.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāya ॥41॥
9.42.2: kathamasyābhavad vairaṁ kāraṇaṁ kiṁ ca tat prabho,
śaṁsa pr̥ṣṭo mahāprājña na hi tr̥pyāmi te vacaḥ ॥2॥
9.42.5: tatrāsya karma tad ghoraṁ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥5॥
9.42.14: sā dhyātā muninā tena vyākulatvaṁ jagāma ha,
jajñe cainaṁ mahāvīryaṁ mahākopaṁ ca bhāvinī ॥14॥
9.42.16: hatavīrā yathā nārī sābhavad duḥkhitā bhr̥śam,
9.42.19: tathārūpāṁ tu tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā munirāha mahānadīm,
9.42.20: sā tasya vacanaṁ śrutvā jñātvā pāpaṁ cikīrṣitam,
9.42.23: tāṁ kr̥śāṁ ca vivarṇāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā cintāsamanvitām,
uvāca rājan dharmātmā vasiṣṭho dvipadāṁ varaḥ ॥23॥
9.42.24: viśvāmitraḥ śapeddhi tvāṁ mā kr̥thāstvaṁ vicāraṇām ॥24॥
9.42.25: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā kr̥pāśīlasya sā sarit,
cintayāmāsa kauravya kiṁ kr̥tvā sukr̥taṁ bhavet ॥25॥
9.42.26: kr̥tavān hi dayāṁ nityaṁ tasya kāryaṁ hitaṁ mayā ॥26॥
9.42.29: uhyamānaḥ sa tuṣṭāva tadā rājan sarasvatīm ॥29॥
9.42.32: tvameva vāṇī svāhā tvaṁ tavāyattamidaṁ jagat ॥32॥
9.42.37: ubhayoḥ kurvatī vākyaṁ vañcayitvā ca gādhijam,
9.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
9.43.1: sā śaptā tena kruddhena viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā,
9.43.2: tatra te śoṇitaṁ sarve pibantaḥ sukhamāsate ॥2॥
9.43.5: prāpya prītiṁ parāṁ cāpi tapolubdhā viśāradāḥ ॥5॥
9.43.8: tān dr̥ṣṭvā rākṣasān rājan munayaḥ saṁśitavratāḥ,
9.43.9: te tu sarve mahābhāgāḥ samāgamya mahāvratāḥ,
9.43.10: kāraṇaṁ brūhi kalyāṇi kimarthaṁ te hrado hyayam,
9.43.11: duḥkhitāmatha tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ūcuste vai tapodhanāḥ ॥11॥
9.43.12: kariṣyanti tu yat prāptaṁ sarva eva tapodhanāḥ ॥12॥
9.43.16: teṣāṁ tu sā prabhāveṇa prakr̥tisthā sarasvatī,
9.43.17: nirmuktā ca saricchreṣṭhā vibabhau sā yathā purā,
9.43.19: ūcustān vai munīn sarvān kr̥pāyuktān punaḥ punaḥ,
9.43.20: na ca naḥ kāmakāro’yaṁ yad vayaṁ pāpakāriṇaḥ,
9.43.21: yat pāpaṁ vardhate’smākaṁ tataḥ smo brahmarākṣasāḥ,
9.43.22: evaṁ hi vaiśyaśūdrāṇāṁ kṣatriyāṇāṁ tathaiva ca,
ye brāhmaṇān pradviṣanti te bhavantīha rākṣasāḥ ॥22॥
9.43.25: teṣāṁ tu vacanaṁ śrutvā tuṣṭuvustāṁ mahānadīm,
9.43.29: mokṣārthaṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca nadīṁ tāṁ pratyacodayan,
maharṣīṇāṁ mataṁ jñātvā tataḥ sā saritāṁ varā ॥29॥
9.43.30: tasyāṁ te rākṣasāḥ snātvā tanūstyaktvā divaṅgatāḥ ॥30॥
9.43.32: tasmiṁstīrthe vare snātvā vimuktaḥ pāpmanā kila,
9.43.35: na cārdreṇa na śuṣkeṇa na rātrau nāpi cāhani ॥35॥
9.43.36: evaṁ sa kr̥tvā samayaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nīhāramīśvaraḥ ॥36॥
9.43.38: bho bho mitraghna pāpeti bruvāṇaṁ śakramantikāt,
evaṁ sa śirasā tena codyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥38॥
9.43.40: eṣā puṇyajalā śakra kr̥tā munibhireva tu ॥40॥
9.43.42: iha tvaṁ yaja devendra dada dānānyanekaśaḥ ॥42॥
9.43.43: ityuktaḥ sa sarasvatyāḥ kuñje vai janamejaya ॥43॥
9.43.44: sa muktaḥ pāpmanā tena brahmavadhyākr̥tena ca ॥44॥
9.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
9.44.2: yasmin deśe ca kāle ca yathā ca vadatāṁ vara,
yaiścābhiṣikto bhagavān vidhinā yena ca prabhuḥ ॥2॥
9.44.3: skando yathā ca daityānāmakarot kadanaṁ mahat,
tathā me sarvamācakṣva paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥3॥
9.44.7: na caiva dhārayāmāsa garbhaṁ tejomayaṁ tadā ॥7॥
9.44.12: tāsāṁ viditvā bhāvaṁ taṁ mātr̥̄ṇāṁ bhagavān prabhuḥ,
9.44.13: taṁ prabhāvaṁ samālakṣya tasya bālasya kr̥ttikāḥ,
9.44.14: sa śailaḥ kāñcanaḥ sarvaḥ sambabhau kurusattama ॥14॥
9.44.15: vardhatā caiva garbheṇa pr̥thivī tena rañjitā,
9.44.17: śamena tapasā caiva vīryeṇa ca samanvitaḥ,
9.44.18: sa tasmin kāñcane divye śarastambe śriyā vr̥taḥ,
9.44.20: anvāste ca nadī devaṁ gaṅgā vai saritāṁ varā,
9.44.22: tatrainaṁ samupātiṣṭhat sākṣād vāṇī ca kevalā ॥22॥
9.44.38: evaṁ sa kr̥tvā hyātmānaṁ caturdhā bhagavān prabhuḥ ॥38॥
9.44.43: tato rudraśca devī ca pāvakaśca pitāmaham,
9.44.49: tato muhūrtaṁ sa dhyātvā devānāṁ śreyasi sthitaḥ,
9.44.52: samantapañcake yā vai triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā ॥52॥
9.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne kumārābhiṣekopakrame catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
9.45.4: dhātā caiva vidhātā ca tathā caivānilānalau ॥4॥
9.45.5: pūṣṇā bhagenāryamṇā ca aṁśena ca vivasvatā,
rudraśca sahito dhīmān mitreṇa varuṇena ca ॥5॥
9.45.13: aditirdevamātā ca hrīḥ śrīḥ svāhā sarasvatī,
umā śacī sinīvālī tathā cānumatiḥ kuhūḥ ॥13॥
9.45.14: rākā ca dhiṣaṇā caiva patnyaścānyā divaukasām,
9.45.19: jagr̥huste tadā rājan sarva eva divaukasaḥ,
9.45.22: purā yathā mahārāja varuṇaṁ vai jaleśvaram,
9.45.23: tasmai brahmā dadau prīto balino vātaraṁhasaḥ ॥23॥
9.45.27: sa hi devāsure yuddhe daityānāṁ bhīmakarmaṇām,
9.45.31: tau sūryaḥ kārtikeyāya dadau prītaḥ pratāpavān ॥31॥
9.45.34: parighaṁ ca vaṭaṁ caiva bhīmaṁ ca sumahābalam,
9.45.36: tau hi śatrūn mahendrasya jaghnatuḥ samare bahūn ॥36॥
9.45.37: cakraṁ vikramakaṁ caiva saṅkramaṁ ca mahābalam,
9.45.39: kundaṁ ca kusumaṁ caiva kumudaṁ ca mahāyaśāḥ,
9.45.41: suvrataṁ satyasandhaṁ ca dadau mitro mahātmane,
9.45.44: pūṣā ca pārṣadau prādāt kārtikeyāya bhārata,
9.45.51: unmādaṁ śaṅkukarṇaṁ ca puṣpadantaṁ tathaiva ca ॥51॥
9.45.55: śr̥ṇu nāmāni cāpyeṣāṁ ye’nye skandasya sainikāḥ ॥55॥
9.45.56: śaṅkukarṇo nikumbhaśca padmaḥ kumuda eva ca ॥56॥
9.45.113: ete cānye ca bahavo mahāpāriṣadā nr̥pa ॥113॥
9.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi balarāmatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne skandābhiṣeke pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
9.46.4: apsu jātā ca gopālī br̥hadambālikā tathā,
9.46.5: vasudāmā ca dāmā ca viśokā nandinī tathā,
9.46.6: śatruñjayā tathā caiva krodhanā śalabhī kharī ॥6॥
9.46.9: santānikā ca kauravya kamalā ca mahābalā ॥9॥
9.46.10: sudāmā bahudāmā ca suprabhā ca yaśasvinī,
9.46.13: dhanadā suprasādā ca bhavadā ca jaleśvarī,
eḍī bheḍī sameḍī ca vetālajananī tathā ॥13॥
9.46.14: kaṇḍūtiḥ kālikā caiva devamitrā ca bhārata,
9.46.16: utkrāthinī jalelā ca mahāvegā ca kaṅkaṇā,
9.46.17: mandodarī ca muṇḍī ca koṭarā meghavāhinī ॥17॥
9.46.20: khyātā dahadahā caiva tathā dhamadhamā nr̥pa,
9.46.27: gaṇā ca sugaṇā caiva tathā bhītyatha kāmadā,
9.46.28: paśudā vittadā caiva sukhadā ca mahāyaśāḥ,
9.46.29: naukarṇī mukhakarṇī ca viśirā manthinī tathā ॥29॥
9.46.43: ete cānye ca bahavo gaṇāḥ śatrubhayaṅkarāḥ ॥43॥
9.46.48: na sā vijānāti raṇāt kadācid vinivartitum ॥48॥
9.46.50: dadau prītyā kumārāya daṇḍaṁ caiva br̥haspatiḥ ॥50॥
9.46.52: kr̥ṣṇājinaṁ tato brahmā brahmaṇyāya dadau prabhuḥ ॥52॥
9.46.59: tuṣṭuvuste kumāraṁ tu sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ,
9.46.60: ripūn hantāsmi samare ye vo vadhacikīrṣavaḥ ॥60॥
9.46.63: sa niryayau mahāseno mahatyā senayā vr̥taḥ,
vadhāya yudhi daityānāṁ rakṣārthaṁ ca divaukasām ॥63॥
9.46.68: dr̥ṣṭvā ca sa tataḥ kruddhaḥ skandastejobalānvitaḥ ॥68॥
9.46.73: tataḥ prīto mahāseno jaghāna bhagavān prabhuḥ,
9.46.79: dagdhāḥ sahasraśo daityā nādaiḥ skandasya cāpare,
9.46.82: bāṇo nāmātha daiteyo baleḥ putro mahābalaḥ,
9.46.87: śocyāmapi daśāṁ prāpto rarājeva sa parvataḥ ॥87॥
9.46.90: sa caiva bhagavān kruddho daityendrasya sutaṁ tadā ॥90॥
9.46.91: bibheda krauñcaṁ śaktyā ca pāvakiḥ paravīrahā ॥91॥
9.46.92: śaktiḥ kṣiptā raṇe tasya pāṇimeti punaḥ punaḥ ॥92॥
9.46.94: tataḥ sa bhagavān devo nihatya vibudhadviṣaḥ ॥94॥
9.46.95: tato dundubhayo rājan neduḥ śaṅkhāśca bhārata ॥95॥
9.46.100: ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva caturdhā ca mahābalam,
9.46.103: aiśvaryāṇi ca tatrastho dadāvīśaḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
9.46.105: taijasaṁ nāma tat tīrthaṁ yatra pūrvamapāṁ patiḥ,
9.46.107: pūjya tīrthavaraṁ tacca spr̥ṣṭvā toyaṁ ca lāṅgalī ॥107॥
9.46.108: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ parimr̥cchasi,
9.46.108d1: senānīśca kr̥to rājan bāla eva mahābalaḥ,
9.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne tārakavadhe ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
9.47.2: prahr̥ṣṭāni ca romāṇi prasannaṁ ca mano mama ॥2॥
9.47.3: abhiṣekaṁ kumārasya daityānāṁ ca vadhaṁ tathā,
śrutvā me paramā prītirbhūyaḥ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥3॥
9.47.4: apāṁ patiḥ kathaṁ hyasminnabhiṣiktaḥ purā suraiḥ,
tanme brūhi mahāprājña kuśalo hyasi sattama ॥4॥
9.47.6: yathāsmān surarāṭ śakro bhayebhyaḥ pāti sarvadā ॥6॥
9.47.7: tathā tvamapi sarvāsāṁ saritāṁ vai patirbhava,
vāsaśca te sadā deva sāgare makarālaye ॥7॥
9.47.8: somena sārdhaṁ ca tava hānivr̥ddhī bhaviṣyataḥ ॥8॥
9.47.10: abhiṣicya tato devā varuṇaṁ yādasāṁ patim ॥10॥
9.47.14: naṣṭo na dr̥śyate yatra śamīgarbhe hutāśanaḥ,
9.47.15: agniḥ praṇaṣṭo bhagavān kāraṇaṁ ca na vidmahe ॥15॥
9.47.17: bhr̥goḥ śāpād bhr̥śaṁ bhīto jātavedāḥ pratāpavān ॥17॥
9.47.18: praṇaṣṭe tu tadā vahnau devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ ॥18॥
9.47.23: tatrāplutya tato brahmā saha devaiḥ prabhuḥ purā ॥23॥
9.47.24: tatra snātvā ca dattvā ca vasūni vividhāni ca ॥24॥
9.47.25: kauberaṁ prayayau tīrthaṁ tatra taptvā mahattapaḥ,
9.47.27: gatvā snātvā ca vidhivad brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṁ dadau,
dadr̥śe tatra tat sthānaṁ kaubere kānanottame ॥27॥
9.47.31: vāhanaṁ cāsya tad dattaṁ haṁsayuktaṁ manojavam,
9.47.32: tatrāplutya balo rājan dattvā dāyāṁśca puṣkalān,
9.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
9.48.3: bhartā me devarājaḥ syāditi niścitya bhāminī ॥3॥
9.48.5: tasyāstu tena vr̥ttena tamasā ca viśāmpate,
bhaktyā ca bhagavān prītaḥ parayā pākaśāsanaḥ ॥5॥
9.48.7: sā taṁ dr̥ṣṭvogratapasaṁ vasiṣṭhaṁ tapatāṁ varam,
9.48.8: uvāca niyamajñā ca kalyāṇī sā priyaṁvadā,
9.48.9: śakrabhaktyā ca te pāṇiṁ na dāsyāmi kathañcana ॥9॥
9.48.11: ityukto bhagavān devaḥ smayanniva nirīkṣya tām,
9.48.12: ugraṁ tapaścarasi vai viditā me’si suvrate,
9.48.14: tapasā tāni prāpyāṇi tapomūlaṁ mahat sukham ॥14॥
9.48.15: iti kr̥tvā tapo ghoraṁ dehaṁ saṁnyasya mānavāḥ,
devatvaṁ yānti kalyāṇi śr̥ṇuṣvaikaṁ vaco mama ॥15॥
9.48.17: āmantryatāṁ tu kalyāṇīṁ tato japyaṁ jajāpa saḥ,
9.48.19: tataḥ prataptā sā rājan vāgyatā vigataklamā ॥19॥
9.48.21: na ca sma tānyapacyanta dinaṁ ca kṣayamabhyagāt ॥21॥
9.48.23: pādau prakṣipya sā pūrvaṁ pāvake cārudarśanā,
9.48.28: na ca tasyā manoduḥkhaṁ svalpamapyabhavat tadā ॥28॥
9.48.30: prīto’smi te śubhe bhaktyā tapasā niyamena ca ॥30॥
9.48.31: tasmād yo’bhimataḥ kāmaḥ sa te sampatsyate śubhe,
dehaṁ tyaktvā mahābhāge tridive mayi vatsyasi ॥31॥
9.48.32: idaṁ ca te tīrthavaraṁ sthiraṁ loke bhaviṣyati,
9.48.34: tataste vai mahābhāgā gatvā tatra susaṁśitāḥ ॥34॥
9.48.36: te kr̥tvā cāśramaṁ tatra nyavasanta tapasvinaḥ ॥36॥
9.48.38: brāhmaṁ rūpaṁ tataḥ kr̥tvā mahādevo mahāyaśāḥ ॥38॥
9.48.39: pratyuvāca tataḥ sā taṁ brāhmaṇaṁ cārudarśanā ॥39॥
9.48.42: divyā manoramāḥ puṇyāḥ kathāḥ śuśrāva sā tadā,
9.48.44: tataḥ sa bhagavān prītaḥ provācārundhatīṁ tataḥ ॥44॥
9.48.45: prīto’smi tava dharmajñe tapasā niyamena ca ॥45॥
9.48.47: asyāśca yat tapo viprā na samaṁ sanmataṁ mama ॥47॥
9.48.48: anaśnanyā pacantyā ca samā dvādaśa pāritāḥ ॥48॥
9.48.49: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva kalyāṇi yat te’bhilaṣitaṁ hr̥di ॥49॥
9.48.53: saptarṣibhiḥ stuto devastato lokaṁ yayau tadā,
9.48.54: evaṁ siddhiḥ parā prāptā arundhatyā viśuddhayā ॥54॥
9.48.55: viśeṣo hi tvayā bhadre vrate hyasmin samarpitaḥ ॥55॥
9.48.56: viśeṣaṁ tava kalyāṇi prayacchāmi varaṁ vare ॥56॥
9.48.57: arundhatyā varastasyā yo datto vai mahātmanā,
tasya cāhaṁ prabhāveṇa tava kalyāṇi tejasā ॥57॥
9.48.59: sa snātvā prāpsyate lokān dehanyāsāt sudurlabhān,
9.48.60: śrutāvatīṁ tataḥ puṇyāṁ jagāma tridivaṁ punaḥ,
gate vajradhare rājaṁstatra varṣaṁ papāta ha ॥60॥
9.48.62: utsr̥jya tu śubhā dehaṁ jagāmāsya ca bhāryatām ॥62॥
9.48.63: tapasogreṇa taṁ labdhvā tena reme sahācyuta,
kā tasyā bhagavan mātā kva saṁvr̥ddhā ca śobhanā,
śrotumicchāmyahaṁ vipra paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥63॥
9.48.65: sa tu jagrāha tadretaḥ kareṇa japatāṁ varaḥ ॥65॥
9.48.66: tadāpatat parṇapuṭe tatra sā sambhavat sutā,
9.48.67: nāma cāsyāḥ sa kr̥tavān bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ,
sve ca tāmāśrame nyasya jagāma himavadvanam ॥67॥
9.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne badarapācanatīrthakathane aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
9.49.1: indratīrthaṁ tato gatvā yadūnāṁ pravaro balaḥ,
9.49.5: tasya nāmnā ca tat tīrthaṁ śivaṁ puṇyaṁ sanātanam,
9.49.7: śubhaṁ tīrthavaraṁ tasmād rāmatīrthaṁ jagāma ha,
9.49.9: pradadau dakṣiṇāṁ caiva pr̥thivīṁ vai sasāgarām ॥9॥
9.49.19: tasyā nadyāstu tīre vai sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ,
9.49.21: ete cānye ca bahavo yogasiddhāḥ sahasraśaḥ,
9.49.23: samprāpya paramaṁ yogaṁ siddhiṁ ca paramāṁ gataḥ ॥23॥
9.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
9.50.1: tasminneva tu dharmātmā vasati sma tapodhanaḥ,
9.50.2: karmaṇā manasā vācā samaḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu ॥2॥
9.50.7: taṁ tatra vasamānaṁ tu jaigīṣavyaṁ mahāmunim ॥7॥
9.50.10: sa dr̥ṣṭvā bhikṣurūpeṇa prāptaṁ tatra mahāmunim ॥10॥
9.50.11: gauravaṁ paramaṁ cakre prītiṁ ca vipulāṁ tathā,
9.50.13: cintā sumahatī jātā muniṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahādyutim,
9.50.15: gacchanneva sa dharmātmā samudraṁ saritāṁ patim ॥15॥
9.50.17: kathaṁ bhikṣurayaṁ prāptaḥ samudre snāta eva ca,
9.50.21: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā cāplutaṁ toye sāgare sāgaropamam ॥21॥
9.50.24: mayā dr̥ṣṭaḥ samudre ca āśrame ca kathaṁ tvayam,
9.50.27: apaśyad vai divaṁ yāntaṁ jaigīṣavyaṁ sa devalaḥ ॥27॥
9.50.28: tasmāt tu pitr̥lokaṁ taṁ vrajantaṁ so’nvapaśyata,
9.50.31: darśaṁ ca paurṇamāsaṁ ca ye yajanti tapodhanāḥ,
9.50.33: agniṣṭutena ca tathā ye yajanti tapodhanāḥ ॥33॥
9.50.37: sarvamedhaṁ ca duṣprāpaṁ tathā sautrāmaṇiṁ ca ye ॥37॥
9.50.40: rudrāṇāṁ ca vasūnāṁ ca sthānaṁ yacca br̥haspateḥ ॥40॥
9.50.41: āruhya ca gavāṁ lokaṁ prayāto brahmasatriṇām ॥41॥
9.50.45: prabhāvaṁ suvratatvaṁ ca siddhiṁ yogasya cātulām,
9.50.46: jaigīṣavyaṁ na paśyāmi taṁ śaṁsadhvaṁ mahaujasam ॥46॥
9.50.47: etadicchāmyahaṁ śrotuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me,
śr̥ṇu devala bhūtārthaṁ śaṁsatāṁ no dr̥ḍhavrata ॥47॥
9.50.48: jaigīṣavyaḥ sa vai lokaṁ śāśvataṁ brahmaṇo gataḥ,
sa śrutvā vacanaṁ teṣāṁ siddhānāṁ brahmasatriṇām ॥48॥
9.50.49: tataḥ siddhāsta ūcurhi devalaṁ punareva ha ॥49॥
9.50.51: teṣāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā siddhānāṁ devalaḥ punaḥ,
9.50.55: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā upadeśaṁ cakāra saḥ ॥55॥
9.50.56: vidhiṁ ca yogasya paraṁ kāryākāryasya śāstrataḥ,
9.50.58: devalastu vacaḥ śrutvā bhūtānāṁ karuṇaṁ tathā ॥58॥
9.50.59: diśo daśa vyāharatāṁ mokṣaṁ tyaktuṁ mano dadhe,
9.50.60: punarno devalaḥ kṣūdro nūnaṁ chetsyati durmatiḥ ॥60॥
9.50.62: mokṣe gārhasthyadharme vā kiṁ nu śreyaskaraṁ bhavet,
9.50.64: prāptavān paramāṁ siddhiṁ paraṁ yogaṁ ca bhārata,
9.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
9.51.9: retaḥ skannaṁ sarasvatyāṁ tat sā jagrāha nimnagā ॥9॥
9.51.10: kukṣau cāpyadadhād hr̥ṣṭā tad retaḥ puruṣarṣabha,
sā dadhāra ca taṁ garbhaṁ putrahetormahānadī ॥10॥
9.51.11: suṣuve cāpi samaye putraṁ sā saritāṁ varā,
jagāma putramādāya tamr̥ṣiṁ prati ca prabho ॥11॥
9.51.12: r̥ṣisaṁsadi taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sā nadī munisattamam,
tataḥ provāca rājendra dadatī putramasya tam ॥12॥
9.51.13: brahmarṣe tava putro’yaṁ tvadbhaktyā dhārito mayā,
dr̥ṣṭvā te’psarasaṁ reto yat skannaṁ prāgalambuṣām ॥13॥
9.51.14: tat kukṣiṇā vai brahmarṣe tvadbhaktyā dhr̥tavatyaham,
na vināśamidaṁ gacchet tvatteja iti niścayāt ॥14॥
9.51.16: svasutaṁ cāpyajighrat taṁ mūrdhni premṇā dvijottamaḥ,
9.51.18: ityuktvā sa tu tuṣṭāva vacobhirvai mahānadīm ॥18॥
9.51.24: evaṁ sā saṁstutānena varaṁ labdhvā mahānadī ॥24॥
9.51.26: na copalebhe bhagavān śakraḥ praharaṇaṁ tadā ॥26॥
9.51.27: tato’bravīt surān śakro na me śakyā mahāsurāḥ ॥27॥
9.51.32: sa hi tīvreṇa tapasā sambhr̥taḥ paramarṣiṇā ॥32॥
9.51.39: gamanāya matiṁ cakre taṁ provāca sarasvatī,
9.51.48: sa tānāha na me dharmo naśyediti punarmunīn,
yo hyadharmeṇa vai brūyād gr̥hṇīyād yo’pyadharmataḥ ॥48॥
9.51.49: hīyetāṁ tāvubhau kṣipraṁ syātāṁ vā vairiṇāvubhau,
na hāyanairna palitairna vittena na bandhubhiḥ ॥49॥
9.51.50: r̥ṣayaścakrire dharmaṁ yo’nūcānaḥ sa no mahān,
9.51.52: muṣṭiṁ muṣṭiṁ tataḥ sarve darbhāṇāṁ te hyupāharan,
9.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
9.52.1: kimarthaṁ ca tapastepe ko vāsyā niyamo’bhavat ॥1॥
9.52.2: ākhyāhi tattvamakhilaṁ yathā tapasi sā sthitā ॥2॥
9.52.3: sa taptvā vipulaṁ rājaṁstapo vai tapatāṁ varaḥ ॥3॥
9.52.4: tāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā muniḥ prītaḥ kuṇirgargo mahāyaśāḥ ॥4॥
9.52.6: upavāsaiḥ pūjayantī pitr̥̄n devāṁśca sā purā ॥6॥
9.52.8: ātmanaḥ sadr̥śaṁ sā tu bhartāraṁ nānvapaśyata,
9.52.10: vārdhakena ca rājendra tapasā caiva karśitā,
sā nāśakad yadā gantuṁ padāt padamapi svayam ॥10॥
9.52.11: cakāra gamane buddhiṁ paralokāya vai tadā,
moktukāmāṁ tu tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śarīraṁ nārado’bravīt ॥11॥
9.52.13: tapaḥ paramakaṁ prāptaṁ na tu lokāstvayā jitāḥ,
9.52.16: yadyekarātraṁ vastavyaṁ tvayā saha mayeti ha,
tatheti sā pratiśrutya tasmai pāṇiṁ dadau tadā ॥16॥
9.52.17: cakre ca pāṇigrahaṇaṁ tasyodvāhaṁ ca gālaviḥ ॥17॥
9.52.19: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gālaviḥ prīto dīpayantīmiva śriyā,
uvāsa ca kṣapāmekāṁ prabhāte sābravīcca tam ॥19॥
9.52.20: yastvayā samayo vipra kr̥to me tapatāṁ vara,
tenoṣitāsmi bhadraṁ te svasti te’stu vrajāmyaham ॥20॥
9.52.22: yo brahmacaryaṁ varṣāṇi phalaṁ tasya labheta saḥ ॥22॥
9.52.23: evamuktvā tataḥ sādhvī dehaṁ tyaktvā divaṁ gatā,
9.52.26: tathaiva brahmacaryaṁ ca svargasya ca gatiḥ śubhā,
9.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
9.53.4: purā kila kuruṁ rāma karṣantaṁ satatotthitam,
9.53.5: kimidaṁ vartate rājan prayatnena pareṇa ca,
9.53.6: iha ye puruṣāḥ kṣetre mariṣyanti śatakrato,
9.53.7: avahasya tataḥ śakro jagāma tridivaṁ punaḥ,
9.53.9: yadā tu tapasogreṇa cakarṣa vasudhāṁ nr̥paḥ,
9.53.11: yadi hyatra pramītā vai svargaṁ gacchanti mānavāḥ,
9.53.12: alaṁ khedena bhavataḥ kriyatāṁ vacanaṁ mama ॥12॥
9.53.13: yudhi vā nihatāḥ samyagapi tiryaggatā nr̥pa ॥13॥
9.53.14: tathāstviti tato rājā kuruḥ śakramuvāca ha ॥14॥
9.53.17: nātaḥ parataraṁ puṇyaṁ bhūmeḥ sthānaṁ bhaviṣyati,
iha tapsyanti ye kecittapaḥ paramakaṁ narāḥ ॥17॥
9.53.18: dehatyāgena te sarve yāsyanti brahmaṇaḥ kṣayam,
ye punaḥ puṇyabhājo vai dānaṁ dāsyanti mānavāḥ ॥18॥
9.53.19: ye ceha nityaṁ manujā nivatsyanti śubhaiṣiṇaḥ ॥19॥
9.53.20: yamasya viṣayaṁ te tu na drakṣyanti kadācana,
9.53.21: api cātra svayaṁ śakro jagau gāthāṁ surādhipaḥ ॥21॥
9.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne kurukṣetrakathane tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
9.54.1: kurukṣetraṁ tato dr̥ṣṭvā dattvā dāyāṁśca sātvataḥ,
9.54.4: te tu sarve mahātmānamūcū rājan halāyudham,
9.54.5: atrāsya vidhivad yajñāḥ sarve vr̥ttāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥5॥
9.54.8: sā tu taptvā tapo ghoraṁ duścaraṁ strījanena ha,
9.54.9: śrutvā r̥ṣīṇāṁ vacanamāśramaṁ taṁ jagāma ha,
9.54.10: nātidūraṁ tato gatvā nagaṁ tāladhvajo balī ॥10॥
9.54.11: puṇyaṁ tīrthavaraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vismayaṁ paramaṁ gataḥ,
9.54.13: āplutaḥ salile puṇye suśīte vimale śucau,
9.54.15: taṁ deśaṁ kārapavanād yamunāyāṁ jagāma ha ॥15॥
9.54.16: snātvā tatra ca dharmātmā parāṁ prītimavāpya ca,
9.54.17: tathā tu tiṣṭhatāṁ teṣāṁ nārado bhagavānr̥ṣiḥ ॥17॥
9.54.18: ājagāmātha taṁ deśaṁ yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ,
9.54.19: kacchapīṁ sukhaśabdāṁ tāṁ gr̥hya vīṇāṁ manoramām ॥19॥
9.54.20: prakartā kalahānāṁ ca nityaṁ ca kalahapriyaḥ ॥20॥
9.54.21: taṁ deśamagamad yatra śrīmān rāmo vyavasthitaḥ,
pratyutthāya ca taṁ samyak pūjayitvā yatavratam ॥21॥
9.54.22: devarṣiṁ paryapr̥cchat sa yathā vr̥ttaṁ kurūn prati,
9.54.24: kimavasthaṁ tu tat kṣatraṁ ye tu tatrābhavan nr̥pāḥ,
9.54.27: ete cānye ca bahavastatra tatra mahābalāḥ,
priyān prāṇān parityajya jayārthaṁ kauravasya vai ॥27॥
9.54.28: ahatāṁstu mahābāho śr̥ṇu me tatra mādhava ॥28॥
9.54.30: te’pi vai vidrutā rāma diśo daśa bhayāt tadā,
9.54.31: śayānaṁ dhārtarāṣṭraṁ tu salile stambhite tadā ॥31॥
9.54.32: sa tudyamāno balavān vāgbhī rāma samantataḥ ॥32॥
9.54.33: utthitaḥ sa hradād vīraḥ pragr̥hya mahatīṁ gadām,
sa cāpyupagato yoddhuṁ bhīmena saha sāmpratam ॥33॥
9.54.34: yadi kautūhalaṁ te’sti vraja mādhava mā ciram,
9.54.37: tataḥ prītamanā rāmaḥ śrutvā tīrthaphalaṁ mahat,
9.54.39: sadā na śocanti paratra ceha ca ॥39॥
9.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevatīrthayātrāyāṁ sārasvatopākhyāne catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
9.55.2: mama putraḥ kathaṁ bhīmaṁ pratyayudhyata sañjaya ॥2॥
9.55.4: dr̥ṣṭvā lāṅgalinaṁ rājā pratyutthāya ca bhārata,
9.55.7: kurukṣetraṁ paraṁ puṇyaṁ pāvanaṁ svargyameva ca,
9.55.8: tatra vai yotsyamānā ye dehaṁ tyakṣyanti mānavāḥ,
teṣāṁ svarge dhruvo vāsaḥ śakreṇa saha māriṣa ॥8॥
9.55.10: saṅgrāme nidhanaṁ prāpya dhruvaṁ svarge bhaviṣyati ॥10॥
9.55.12: tato duryodhano rājā pragr̥hya mahatīṁ gadām,
9.55.14: vātikāścāraṇā ye tu dr̥ṣṭvā te harṣamāgatāḥ,
9.55.18: tasmin deśe tvaniriṇe te tu yuddhamarocayan,
tato bhīmo mahākoṭiṁ gadāṁ gr̥hyātha varmabhr̥t ॥18॥
9.55.26: āhvayāmāsa nr̥patiṁ siṁhaṁ siṁho yathā vane,
9.55.44: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaṁ caiva kr̥ṣṇena ca mahātmanā,
9.55.45: idaṁ vyavasitaṁ yuddhaṁ mama bhīmasya cobhayoḥ ॥45॥
9.55.50: tau tathā tu mahārāja gadāhastau suduḥsahau,
9.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi yuddhārambhe pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
9.56.3: ājñāpya sarvān nr̥patīn bhuktvā cemāṁ vasundharām,
9.56.4: bhūtvā hi jagato nātho hyanātha iva me sutaḥ,
9.56.5: aho duḥkhaṁ mahat prāptaṁ putreṇa mama sañjaya,
9.56.6: ājuhāva tadā pārthaṁ yuddhāya yudhi vīryavān ॥6॥
9.56.14: aśarīrā mahānādāḥ śrūyante sma tadā nr̥pa ॥14॥
9.56.16: naiṣa śakto raṇe jetuṁ mandātmā māṁ suyodhanaḥ,
adya krodhaṁ vimokṣyāmi nigūḍhaṁ hr̥daye ciram ॥16॥
9.56.24: adya saukhyaṁ tu rājendra kururājasya durmateḥ ॥24॥
9.56.25: samāptaṁ ca mahārāja nārīṇāṁ darśanaṁ punaḥ,
9.56.26: prāṇān śriyaṁ ca rājyaṁ ca tyaktvā śeṣyati bhūtale,
rājā ca dhr̥tarāṣṭro’dya śrutvā putraṁ nipātitam ॥26॥
9.56.30: smara tad duṣkr̥taṁ karma yad vr̥ttaṁ vāraṇāvate,
9.56.31: dyūtena vañcito rājā yat tvayā saubalena ca,
vane duḥkhaṁ ca yat prāptamasmābhistvatkr̥taṁ mahat ॥31॥
9.56.32: tat sarvaṁ pātayāmyadya diṣṭyā dr̥ṣṭo’si durmate ॥32॥
9.56.34: hato droṇaśca karṇaśca tathā śalyaḥ pratāpavān,
9.56.36: ete cānye ca bahavo nihatāstvatkr̥te nr̥pāḥ,
9.56.38: kiṁ katthanena bahunā yudhyasva tvaṁ vr̥kodara,
9.56.39: na hi duryodhanaḥ kṣudra kenacit tvadvidhena vai,
9.56.41: kiṁ vācā bahunoktena katthitena ca durmate,
vāṇī sampadyatāmeṣā karmaṇā mā ciraṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥41॥
9.56.42: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā sarva evābhyapūjayan,
9.56.43: bhūyo dhīrāṁ matiṁ cakre yuddhāya kurunandanaḥ ॥43॥
9.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi gadāyuddhārambhe ṣaṭpañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
9.57.6: tathā tasmin vartamāne saṅkule tumule bhr̥śam,
9.57.8: tau tu dr̥ṣṭvā mahāvīryau samāśvastau nararṣabhau,
9.57.11: samāgamya tato bhūyo bhrātarau balināṁ varau,
9.57.12: dadr̥śuḥ prekṣakā rājan raudrīṁ viśasanīṁ gadām ॥12॥
9.57.15: caraṁśca vividhān mārgān maṇḍalāni ca bhārata,
aśobhata tadā vīro bhūya eva vr̥kodaraḥ ॥15॥
9.57.27: āhatastu tato bhīmaḥ putreṇa tava bhārata ॥27॥
9.57.31: sa caran vividhān mārgān maṇḍalāni ca bhāgaśaḥ ॥31॥
9.57.38: dr̥ṣṭvā vyavasthitaṁ bhīmaṁ tava putro mahābalaḥ ॥38॥
9.57.42: tāṁ nāmr̥ṣyata kauravyo gadāṁ pratihatāṁ raṇe ॥42॥
9.57.43: sa savyaṁ maṇḍalaṁ rājā udbhrāmya kr̥taniścayaḥ ॥43॥
9.57.44: tayā tvabhihato bhīmaḥ putreṇa tava pāṇḍavaḥ ॥44॥
9.57.46: yad gadābhihato bhīmo nākampata padāt padam,
9.57.48: sā tu moghā gadā rājan patantī bhīmacoditā ॥48॥
9.57.49: āsthāya kauśikān mārgānutpatan sa punaḥ punaḥ ॥49॥
9.57.53: sa tu tena prahāreṇa mātaṅga iva roṣitaḥ ॥53॥
9.57.54: tatastu tarasā bhīmo gadayā tanayaṁ tava ॥54॥
9.57.56: āvidhyata gadāṁ rājan samuddiśya sutaṁ tava,
9.57.58: teṣāṁ tu ninadaṁ śrutvā sr̥ñjayānāṁ nararṣabhaḥ ॥58॥
9.57.62: sa bhūyaḥ śuśubhe pārthastāḍito gadayā raṇe,
9.57.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi gadāyuddhe saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥57॥
9.58.2: kasya vā ko guṇo bhūyānetad vada janārdana ॥2॥
9.58.4: anyāyena tu yudhyan vai hanyādeva suyodhanam ॥4॥
9.58.5: māyayā nirjitā devairasurā iti naḥ śrutam,
virocanastu śakreṇa māyayā nirjitaḥ sa vai ॥5॥
9.58.7: ūrū bhetsyāmi te saṅkhye gadayeti suyodhanam ॥7॥
9.58.10: punareva tu vakṣyāmi pāṇḍaveya nibodha me,
9.58.11: kr̥tvā hi sumahat karma hatvā bhīṣmamukhān kurūn,
jayaḥ prāpto yaśaḥ prāgryaṁ vairaṁ ca pratiyātitam ॥11॥
9.58.12: tadevaṁ vijayaḥ prāptaḥ punaḥ saṁśayitaḥ kr̥taḥ,
9.58.18: ko nveṣa saṁyuge prājñaḥ punardvandve samāhvayet,
api no nirjitaṁ rājyaṁ na hareta suyodhanaḥ ॥18॥
9.58.20: eṣa vaḥ kauravo rājā dhārtarāṣṭro bhaviṣyati ॥20॥
9.58.22: gr̥hya sañjñāṁ tato bhīmo gadayā vyacarad raṇe,
9.58.33: samare pradrutau tau tu vr̥ṣabhākṣau tarasvinau,
9.58.36: avākṣipad gadāṁ tasmin vegena mahatā balī ॥36॥
9.58.37: ākṣipantaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā putrastava viśāmpate,
avāsarpattataḥ sthānāt sā moghā nyapatad bhuvi ॥37॥
9.58.40: duryodhano na taṁ veda pīḍitaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ raṇe,
9.58.41: ato na prāharat tasmai punareva tavātmajaḥ ॥41॥
9.58.46: ūrubhyāṁ prāhiṇod rājan gadāṁ vegena pāṇḍavaḥ ॥46॥
9.58.51: tathā śoṇitavarṣaṁ ca pāṁśuvarṣaṁ ca bhārata ॥51॥
9.58.52: yakṣāṇāṁ rākṣasānāṁ ca piśācānāṁ tathaiva ca ॥52॥
9.58.54: ye tatra vājinaḥ śeṣā gajāśca manujaiḥ saha ॥54॥
9.58.60: duryodhane tadā rājan patite tanaye tava,
9.59.14: tava putraṁ tathā hatvā katthamānaṁ vr̥kodaram,
9.59.16: mā śiro’sya padā mārdīrmā dharmaste’tigo bhavet,
9.59.17: mā sprākṣīrbhīma pādena rājānaṁ jñātimeva ca ॥17॥
9.59.19: utsannapiṇḍo bhrātā ca naitannyāyyaṁ kr̥taṁ tvayā ॥19॥
9.59.22: tāta manyurna te kāryo nātmā śocyastvayā tathā,
9.59.23: yad vayaṁ tvāṁ jighāṁsāmastvaṁ cāsmān kurusattama ॥23॥
9.59.28: bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ caiva putrāṇāṁ tathā vai śokavihvalāḥ ॥28॥
9.59.29: tvamekaḥ susthito rājan svarge te nilayo dhruvaḥ ॥29॥
9.59.30: vayaṁ narakasañjñaṁ vai duḥkhaṁ prāpsyāma dāruṇam,
9.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiravilāpe ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
9.60.4: kurvannārtasvaraṁ ghoraṁ dhig dhig bhīmetyuvāca ha ॥4॥
9.60.5: aho dhig yadadho nābheḥ prahr̥taṁ dharmavigrahe,
naitad dr̥ṣṭaṁ gadāyuddhe kr̥tavān yad vr̥kodaraḥ ॥5॥
9.60.6: adho nābhyā na hantavyamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ,
9.60.7: tasya tat tad bruvāṇasya roṣaḥ samabhavanmahān,
9.60.8: na caiṣa patitaḥ kr̥ṣṇa kevalaṁ matsamo’samaḥ ॥8॥
9.60.10d1: na vivyathe mahārāja dr̥ṣṭvā haladharaṁ balī.
9.60.14: ātmanyapi ca mitre ca viparītaṁ yadā bhavet ॥14॥
9.60.17: iti pūrvaṁ pratijñātaṁ bhīmena hi sabhātale ॥17॥
9.60.18: ūrū te bhetsyate bhīmo gadayeti parantapa ॥18॥
9.60.19: ato doṣaṁ na paśyāmi mā kruddhyasva pralambahan,
yaunaḥ svaiḥ sukhahārdaiśca sambandhaḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥19॥
9.60.20: teṣāṁ vr̥ddhyā hi vr̥ddhirno mā krudhaḥ puruṣarṣabha,
9.60.21: dharmaḥ sucaritaḥ sadbhiḥ sa ca dvābhyāṁ niyacchati,
9.60.23: tadidaṁ vyākulaṁ sarvaṁ kr̥taṁ dharmasya pīḍanāt,
bhīmasenena govinda kāmaṁ tvaṁ tu yathā’’ttha mām ॥23॥
9.60.24: bhavān prakhyāyate loke tasmāt saṁśāmya mā krudhaḥ ॥24॥
9.60.25: prāptaṁ kaliyugaṁ viddhi pratijñāṁ pāṇḍavasya ca,
9.60.25d1: adharmo vidyate nātra yad bhīmo hatavān ripum.
9.60.25d6: babhañja gadayā corū na sthāne na ca maṇḍale.
9.60.26: naiva prītamanā rāmo vacanaṁ prāha saṁsadi ॥26॥
9.60.35: na mamaitat priyaṁ kr̥ṣṇa yad rājānaṁ vr̥kodaraḥ,
padā mūrdhnyaspr̥śat krodhānna ca hr̥ṣye kulakṣaye ॥35॥
9.60.36: bahūni paruṣāṇyuktvā vanaṁ prasthāpitāḥ sma ha ॥36॥
9.60.38: labhatāṁ pāṇḍavaḥ kāmaṁ dharme’dharme ca vā kr̥te ॥38॥
9.60.40: anvamodata tat sarvaṁ yad bhīmena kr̥taṁ yudhi ॥40॥
9.60.40d1: novāca vacanaṁ kiñcid bhrātaraṁ, sādhvasādhu vā.
9.60.47: gato vairasya nidhanaṁ hato rājā suyodhanaḥ,
9.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi baladevasāntvane ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
9.61.7: duṣkaraṁ bhavatā karma raṇe’dya sumahat kr̥tam,
9.61.9: carantaṁ vividhān mārgān maṇḍalāni ca sarvaśaḥ,
9.61.10: vairasya ca gataḥ pāraṁ tvamihānyaiḥ sudurgamam,
9.61.13: mūrdhni teṣāṁ kr̥taḥ pādo diṣṭyā te svena karmaṇā ॥13॥
9.61.14: bhīma diṣṭyā pr̥thivyāṁ te prathitaṁ sumahad yaśaḥ ॥14॥
9.61.15: evaṁ nūnaṁ hate vr̥tre śakraṁ nandanti vandinaḥ,
tathā tvāṁ nihatāmitraṁ vayaṁ nandāma bhārata ॥15॥
9.61.16: adyāpi na vikr̥ṣyante tāni tad viddhi bhārata ॥16॥
9.61.17: tān hr̥ṣṭān puruṣavyāghrān pañcālān pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥17॥
9.61.18: na nyāyyaṁ nihataṁ śatruṁ bhūyo hantuṁ narādhipāḥ ॥18॥
9.61.21: naiṣa yogyo’dya mitraṁ vā śatrurvā puruṣādhamaḥ ॥21॥
9.61.23: iti śrutvā tvadhikṣepaṁ kr̥ṣṇād duryodhano nr̥paḥ ॥23॥
9.61.27: kaṁsadāsasya dāyāda na te lajjāstyanena vai ॥27॥
9.61.28: ūrū bhindhīti bhīmasya smr̥tiṁ mithyā prayacchatā ॥28॥
9.61.30: jihmairupāyairbahubhirna te lajjā na te ghr̥ṇā,
9.61.32: ācāryo nyāsitaḥ śastraṁ kiṁ tanna viditaṁ mayā,
9.61.37: yadi māṁ cāpi karṇaṁ ca bhīṣmadroṇau ca saṁyutau ॥37॥
9.61.38: r̥junā pratiyudhyethā na te syād vijayo dhruvam,
9.61.41: yācyamānaṁ mayā mūḍha pitryamaṁśaṁ na ditsasi ॥41॥
9.61.42: viṣaṁ te bhīmasenāya dattaṁ sarve ca pāṇḍavāḥ ॥42॥
9.61.43: sabhāyāṁ yājñasenī ca kr̥ṣṭā dyūte rajasvalā ॥43॥
9.61.45: jayadrathena pāpena yat kr̥ṣṇā kleśitā vane ॥45॥
9.61.47d5: na jaghāna raṇe karṇaṁ maivaṁ vocaḥ sudurmate.
9.61.47d7: tvaṁ ca bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca droṇo drauṇistathā kr̥paḥ,
9.61.47d8: smara pārthasya vikrāntaṁ gandharveṣu kr̥taṁ tadā,
adharmaḥ ko’tra gāndhāre pāṇḍavairyat kr̥taṁ tvayi.
9.61.47d9: jitavanto raṇe vīrā pāpo’si nidhanaṁ gataḥ.
9.61.49: vr̥ddhā nopāsitāścaiva hitaṁ vākyaṁ na te śrutam,
9.61.50: adhītaṁ vidhivad dattaṁ bhūḥ praśāstā sasāgarā ॥50॥
9.61.51: mūrdhni sthitamamitrāṇāṁ ko nu svantataro mayā,
9.61.52: tadidaṁ nidhanaṁ prāptaṁ ko nu svantataro mayā,
devārhā mānuṣā bhogāḥ prāptā asulabhā nr̥paiḥ ॥52॥
9.61.53: aiśvaryaṁ cottamaṁ prāptaṁ ko nu svantataro mayā,
9.61.54d1: na me viṣādo bhīmena pādena śira āhatam,
kākā vā kaṅkagr̥dhrā vā nidhāsyanti padaṁ kṣaṇāt.
9.61.57: vavau ca surabhirvāyuḥ puṇyagandho mr̥duḥ sukhaḥ,
9.61.59: bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ tathā karṇaṁ bhūriśravasameva ca ॥59॥
9.61.62: naiṣa śakyaḥ kadācit tu hantuṁ dharmeṇa pārthivaḥ,
te vā bhīṣmamukhāḥ sarve maheṣvāsā mahārathāḥ ॥62॥
9.61.64: yadi naivaṁvidhaṁ jātu kuryāṁ jihmamahaṁ raṇe,
kuto vo vijayo bhūyaḥ kuto rājyaṁ kuto dhanam ॥64॥
9.61.65: na śakyā dharmato hantuṁ lokapālairapi svayam ॥65॥
9.61.66: na śakyo dharmato hantuṁ kālenāpīha daṇḍinā ॥66॥
9.61.67: na ca vo hr̥di kartavyaṁ yadayaṁ ghātito ripuḥ,
9.61.71: tataḥ prādhmāpayan śaṅkhān pāñcajanyaṁ ca mādhavaḥ,
9.61.71d4: āpupūre nabhaḥ sarvaṁ pr̥thivī ca cacāla ha.
9.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇapāṇḍavaduryodhanasaṁvāde ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
9.62.11: atha paścāt tataḥ kr̥ṣṇo raśmīnutsr̥jya vājinām,
9.62.15: taṁ tathā bhasmabhūtaṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍusutāḥ prabho,
9.62.17: tanme brūhi mahābāho śrotavyaṁ yadi manyase ॥17॥
9.62.21: diṣṭyā jayasi kaunteya diṣṭyā te śatravo jitāḥ,
9.62.22: tvaṁ cāpi kuśalī rājan mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau,
9.62.24: ānīya madhuparkaṁ māṁ yat purā tvamavocathāḥ,
eṣa bhrātā sakhā caiva tava kr̥ṣṇa dhanañjayaḥ ॥24॥
9.62.26: sa savyasācī guptaste vijayī ca janeśvara,
9.62.32: yato dharmastataḥ kr̥ṣṇo yataḥ kr̥ṣṇastato jayaḥ,
ityevamukte te vīrāḥ śibiraṁ tava bhārata ॥32॥
9.62.33: rajataṁ jātarūpaṁ ca maṇīnatha ca mauktikān ॥33॥
9.62.36: te tu vīrāḥ samāśvasya vāhanānyavamucya ca,
9.62.38: tathetyuktvā hi te sarve pāṇḍavāḥ sātyakistathā,
9.62.40: tatra te gamanaṁ prāptaṁ rocate tava mādhava ॥40॥
9.62.45: sa prāyāt pāṇḍavairuktastat puraṁ sātvatāṁ varaḥ,
9.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi vāsudevapreṣaṇe dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
9.63.2: yadā pūrvaṁ gataḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ śamārthaṁ kauravān prati,
na ca taṁ labdhavān kāmaṁ tato yuddhamabhūdidam ॥2॥
9.63.3: nihateṣu tu yodheṣu hate duryodhane tadā,
9.63.4: vidrute śibire śūnye prāpte yaśasi cottame,
kiṁ nu tat kāraṇaṁ brahman yena kr̥ṣṇo gataḥ punaḥ ॥4॥
9.63.5: na caitat kāraṇaṁ brahmannalpaṁ vipratibhāti me,
9.63.10: ghoreṇa tapasā yuktāṁ trailokyamapi sā dahet ॥10॥
9.63.13: kathaṁ duḥkhamidaṁ tīvraṁ gāndhārī sā sahiṣyati,
9.63.17: yathā sāhyaṁ purā dattaṁ hatāśca vibudhadviṣaḥ ॥17॥
9.63.18: sārathyena ca vārṣṇeya bhavatā hi dhr̥tā vayam ॥18॥
9.63.19: yadi na tvaṁ bhavernāthaḥ phālgunasya mahāraṇe,
kathaṁ śakyo raṇe jetuṁ bhavedeṣa balārṇavaḥ ॥19॥
9.63.21: asmatkr̥te tvayā kr̥ṣṇa vācaḥ suparuṣāḥ śrutāḥ,
śastrāṇāṁ ca nipātā vai vajrasparśopamā raṇe ॥21॥
9.63.22: te ca te saphalā jātā hate duryodhane’cyuta,
tat sarvaṁ na yathā naśyet punaḥ kr̥ṣṇa tathā kuru ॥22॥
9.63.23: sandehadolāṁ prāptaṁ naścetaḥ kr̥ṣṇa jaye sati,
gāndhāryā hi mahābāho krodhaṁ buddhyasva mādhava ॥23॥
9.63.24: sā hi nityaṁ mahābhāgā tapasogreṇa karśitā,
9.63.25: tasyāḥ prasādanaṁ vīra prāptakālaṁ mataṁ mama,
9.63.26: tatra me gamanaṁ prāptaṁ rocate tava mādhava ॥26॥
9.63.27: tvaṁ hi kartā vikartā ca lokānāṁ prabhavāpyayaḥ ॥27॥
9.63.31: āmantrya dārukaṁ prāha rathaḥ sajjo vidhīyatām,
9.63.39: prakṣālya vāriṇā netre hyācamya ca yathāvidhi,
9.63.40: na te’styaviditaṁ kiñcid vr̥ddhasya tava bhārata,
kālasya ca yathāvr̥ttaṁ tat te suviditaṁ prabho ॥40॥
9.63.41: kathaṁ kulakṣayo na syāttathā kṣatrasya bhārata ॥41॥
9.63.43: anye ca bahavaḥ kleśāt tvaśaktairiva sarvadā ॥43॥
9.63.46: droṇena ca saputreṇa vidureṇa ca dhīmatā ॥46॥
9.63.47: yācitastvaṁ śamaṁ nityaṁ na ca tat kr̥tavānasi,
9.63.49: mā ca doṣān mahāprājña pāṇḍaveṣu niveśaya,
9.63.50: etat sarvaṁ tu vijñāya hyātmadoṣakr̥taṁ phalam ॥50॥
9.63.51: kulaṁ vaṁśaśca piṇḍāśca yacca putrakr̥taṁ phalam ॥51॥
9.63.52: tvaṁ caiva kuruśārdūla gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī ॥52॥
9.63.53: mā śuco naraśārdūla pāṇḍavān prati kilbiṣam,
9.63.54: jānāsi ca mahābāho dharmarājasya yā tvayi ॥54॥
9.63.56: dahyate sa divā rātrau na ca śarmādhigacchati,
tvāṁ caiva naraśārdūla gāndhārīṁ ca yaśasvinīm ॥56॥
9.63.59: saubaleyi nibodha tvaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu ॥59॥
9.63.60: jānāsi ca yathā rājñi sabhāyāṁ mama saṁnidhau ॥60॥
9.63.61: uktavatyasi kalyāṇi na ca te tanayaiḥ kr̥tam ॥61॥
9.63.62: śr̥ṇu mūḍha vaco mahyaṁ yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥62॥
9.63.63: evaṁ viditvā kalyāṇi mā sma śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥63॥
9.63.64: pāṇḍavānāṁ vināśāya mā te buddhiḥ kadācana,
9.63.67: sā me vyavasthitā śrutvā tava vākyaṁ janārdana,
9.63.70: samāśvāsya ca gāndhārīṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭraṁ ca mādhavaḥ ॥70॥
9.63.71: tatastvarita utthāya pādau mūrdhnā praṇamya ca ॥71॥
9.63.72: āpr̥cche tvāṁ kuruśreṣṭha mā ca śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥72॥
9.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭragāndhārīsamāśvāsane triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
9.64.1: adhiṣṭhitaḥ padā mūrdhni bhagnasaktho mahīṁ gataḥ,
9.64.3: rājñā yaduktaṁ bhagnena tasmin vyasana āgate ॥3॥
9.64.4: yamayan mūrdhajāṁstatra vīkṣya caiva diśo daśa ॥4॥
9.64.6: bāhū dharaṇyāṁ niṣpiṣya sudurmatta iva dvipaḥ,
9.64.7: bhīṣme śāntanave nāthe karṇe śastrabhr̥tāṁ vare ॥7॥
9.64.8: gautame śakunau cāpi droṇe cāstrabhr̥tāṁ vare,
aśvatthāmni tathā śalye śūre ca kr̥tavarmaṇi ॥8॥
9.64.12: bhūriśravasi karṇe ca bhīṣme droṇe ca śrīmati,
idaṁ cākīrtijaṁ karma nr̥śaṁsaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ kr̥tam ॥12॥
9.64.13: yena te satsu nirvedaṁ gamiṣyanti hi me matiḥ,
9.64.14: adharmeṇa jayaṁ labdhvā ko nu hr̥ṣyeta paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
9.64.16: pratapantaṁ śriyā juṣṭaṁ vartamānaṁ ca bandhuṣu ॥16॥
9.64.17: evaṁ kuryānnaro yo hi sa vai sañjaya pūjitaḥ,
abhijñau yuddhadharmasya mama mātā pitā ca me ॥17॥
9.64.18: tau hi sañjaya duḥkhārtau vijñāpyau vacanāddhi me,
iṣṭaṁ bhr̥tyā bhr̥tāḥ samyag bhūḥ praśāstā sasāgarā ॥18॥
9.64.19: dattā dāyā yathāśakti mitrāṇāṁ ca priyaṁ kr̥tam ॥19॥
9.64.20: amitrā bādhitāḥ sarve ko nu svantataro mayā,
mānitā bāndhavāḥ sarve vaśyaḥ sampūjito janaḥ ॥20॥
9.64.21: tritayaṁ sevitaṁ sarvaṁ ko nu svantataro mayā,
9.64.22: ājāneyaistathā yātaṁ ko nu svantataro mayā,
9.64.23: priyebhyaḥ prakr̥taṁ sādhu ko nu svantataro mayā,
9.64.24: svadharmeṇa jitā lokāḥ ko nu svantataro mayā,
diṣṭyā nāhaṁ jitaḥ saṅkhye parān preṣyavadāśritaḥ ॥24॥
9.64.25: diṣṭyā me vipulā lakṣmīrmr̥te tvanyagatā vibho,
9.64.26: nidhanaṁ tanmayā prāptaṁ ko nu svantataro mayā,
9.64.27: diṣṭyā na vimatiṁ kāñcid bhajitvā tu parājitaḥ,
suptaṁ vātha pramattaṁ vā yathā hanyād viṣeṇa vā ॥27॥
9.64.35: kathaṁ bhrātr̥̄n hatān śrutvā bhartāraṁ ca svasā mama ॥35॥
9.64.36: snuṣābhiḥ prasnuṣābhiśca vr̥ddho rājā pitā mama ॥36॥
9.64.41: pralāpaṁ nr̥pateḥ śrutvā vyadravanta diśo daśa,
9.64.43: dhyātvā ca suciraṁ kālaṁ jagmurārtā yathāgatam ॥43॥
9.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi duryodhanavilāpe catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
9.65.1: vārtikāṇāṁ sakāśāt tu śrutvā duryodhanaṁ hatam,
9.65.9: sāmarṣaṁ taṁ naravyāghraṁ vyāghraṁ nipatitaṁ yathā ॥9॥
9.65.10: te taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā maheṣvāsaṁ bhūtale patitaṁ nr̥pam,
9.65.13: na nūnaṁ vidyate satyaṁ mānuṣe kiñcideva hi,
yatra tvaṁ puruṣavyāghra śeṣe pāṁsuṣu rūṣitaḥ ॥13॥
9.65.14: bhūtvā hi nr̥patiḥ pūrvaṁ samājñāpya ca medinīm,
9.65.15: duḥśāsanaṁ na paśyāmi nāpi karṇaṁ mahāratham,
nāpi tān suhr̥daḥ sarvān kimidaṁ bharatarṣabha ॥15॥
9.65.16: duḥkhaṁ nūnaṁ kr̥tāntasya gatiṁ jñātuṁ kathañcana,
lokānāṁ ca bhavān yatra śeṣe pāṁsuṣu rūṣitaḥ ॥16॥
9.65.17: satr̥ṇaṁ grasate pāṁsuṁ paśya kālasya paryayam ॥17॥
9.65.18: kva te tadamalaṁ chatraṁ vyajanaṁ kva ca pārthiva,
sā ca te mahatī senā kva gatā pārthivottama ॥18॥
9.65.19: yad vai lokagururbhūtvā bhavānetāṁ daśāṁ gataḥ ॥19॥
9.65.21: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā duḥkhitasya viśeṣataḥ,
9.65.22: kr̥pādīn sa tadā vīrān sarvāneva narādhipaḥ ॥22॥
9.65.24: so’yaṁ māṁ samanuprāptaḥ pratyakṣaṁ bhavatāṁ hi yaḥ,
9.65.26: utsāhaśca kr̥to nityaṁ mayā diṣṭyā yuyutsatā,
9.65.28: yadi vedāḥ pramāṇaṁ vo jitā lokā mayākṣayāḥ ॥28॥
9.65.30: sa mayā samanuprāpto nāsmi śocyaḥ kathañcana,
9.65.31: yatitaṁ vijaye nityaṁ daivaṁ tu duratikramam,
9.65.32: tūṣṇīṁ babhūva rājendra rujāsau vihvalo bhr̥śam,
9.65.33: sa ca krodhasamāviṣṭaḥ pāṇau pāṇiṁ nipīḍya ca ॥33॥
9.65.34: pitā me nihataḥ kṣudraiḥ sunr̥śaṁsena karmaṇā ॥34॥
9.65.35: na tathā tena tapyāmi yathā rājaṁstvayādya vai,
śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mahyaṁ satyena vadataḥ prabho ॥35॥
9.65.37: anujñāṁ tu mahārāja bhavān me dātumarhati ॥37॥
9.65.38: iti śrutvā tu vacanaṁ droṇaputrasya kauravaḥ,
9.65.41: saināpatyena bhadraṁ te mama cedicchasi priyam ॥41॥
9.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śalyaparvaṇi gadāparvaṇi aśvatthāmasaināpatyābhiṣeke pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
